Mandipele ngeliti ngubanina owati masiyitye ihangu, ngapandle ko Menzi wetu ? Mapendule no- kuba likulu lamadoda lombuzo.—J. M. V., Kokstadt, 5 May, 1884. *** Nokuba umnumzana obala kwelipepa ezigubungele ngegama lokuba ungu Nyashawe Wasemenyangeni ungumprofite aka- nguye sinina asikatali kakulu. Inye kodwa into esiyaziyo — amazwi ake angokunxila okwandileyo ezixekweni ezikulu aya- bonakala. Oko zavalwayo inkanti zangapandle yimiqodi amadoda, abalazi, abafana, nentombi, nentsapo ukuza ezixe- kweni ukutenga i “ brandy.” Lo m’bali ude wacinga ngokuti fan’ukuba kuko isizwe esifudukayo akubona inkita epuma Edikeni ngo Mgqibelo we 17 May. Ude wacaciselwa ngababini abazo izihlwele ezo ukuba lenkungu nelanga yesuka kwimi- mandla emele i Ncera, ama Regu, u Ngwenya, ama Debe, nama Qibira, o Mabandla, nama Ngcwazwi eze kusela ezinka- ntini. Siqonde apo, sakubona inzwana nenzwakazi zakowetu zihexa ezindleleni, ukuba umzi uhamba ngebanzi eya ema- ncwabeni nase sihogweni. Mnye umhla enyakeni esiva ukuba bekusakuba nje emanyangeni ase Roma; mhla bekuti ibe ngama tyotityoti ekuhlanganeni kwe Anio ne Tiber (imilambo yelo ke leyo.) Oyibalisayo imbali yalomhla we 15 March uti “ Xa bagodukayo bevela emgcobeni apo wokuzukisa u “ Anna Perenna ” (isitixokazi sonyaka ojikelezayo) bayahexa, babe yinto yokubonelwa kuninzi; bade abaninzi abahlangana nabo bati okunene batamsanqelekile.” Weleka ati lom’bali “ Ndike ndababona kufupi nje : nesibonakalo eso sifanale ukuxelwa ; intokazi endala enxilileyo yayirola ngonyawo ixego elinxilileyo.” Sikumbule elibali sakuzibona izanga zalo Mgqibelo. Kanti ke ezi zinto zihla yonke imihla. Incwadi ka “ Nyashawe ” ibifanele ukwetyiswa. *** Amazwi okuncoma awabekiswa kubantu bomzana wakwa Marela ose Debe, kumandla opetwe yinkosi u Kama, ngum’- bali kwelokugqibela mabe akakalityalwa ngabafundi belipepa. Emva koko sike sanetuba lokucanda pakati kwalo lali, satabata ituba lokuqondisisa londlu yom’fundisi isand’ukugqitywa: Sayifumana ifanele ukunconywa. Indlu leyo luxande olune- piko. Isakiwo esihle esibonisa ubugcisa bencibi yalo um’fo abati ngu Makolota. nakuba Iwakiwe ngemiti, olubonayo angati Iwenziwe ngezitena. Ikambile ngapakati zezezitena. Kwizindlu enazo kuko eyokubuta ekwayeyokudlela, neyokulala, nacingela kuyo um’fundisi, neyokupekela. Le yokupekela ngati inkulu kakulu ib’ingeyahlulwe kubini enye yayeyoku- gcina ukudla. Sitabata elituba lokubancoma abantu base JUNE 2, 1884. Debe ngomsebenzi wobudoda onjengalo basand’ukuwugqiba, sibancoma ngokukodwa kuba bewenze lomsebenzi ngexesha elibi kunene lelanga. Sifuna ukubona izenzo ezinje ke pakati kweramente zakowetu eziti zifuna abafundisi bebala lazo. Aba bafundisi betu bebefanele ukulungiselelwa kakulu siti ukuze babehle babone nabamhlope ukuba sinokuzenzela imise- benzi yetu njengabanye abantu. Wandile umoya wokunga- mtembi umntu omnyama ukuba unokuzenzela into yake yedwa efanelekileyo, ngapandle koncedo lomhlope. Izenzo ezinjengezi zakwa Marela zizitandatu ziya kubonisa ubuntu betu. Ofunayo angaya kuhlutisa amehlo ake. * * * Site tina sakuyibona lendlu eyakiwe libandla lase Debe salusizi ngento enye—ukuba ingabi ib’ibete yavulwa ngentla- nganiso kwamenywa izizwe. Intlanganiso ib’ingebite yalituba elihle lokubancoma abafanele ukunconywa nokubabonisa ukudeleka kwabo abahlalisene nabafundisi babo njengabo bamele la’mangwana ungasentla ko Marela. I Peula linexesha elide lamabelwayo um’fundisi ontsundu, kodwa nanamhla alikazanga lam’misela nendlu. Ude obekona kufupi nje wazi- misela eyake. Isakiwo esifanelekileyo. Endaweni yoku- m’bulela ukuba ebancedile emsebenzini abebebutuntu ukuwe- nza basuka bazama ukuduba intliziyo yeso sicaka se Nkosi ngokuti indlu leyo masiyicite ukuba asifuni kubanika ze (kuba ixabiso abebesiti bayiqesha ngalo siti tina lilize.) Indlu yom’fundisi ke ebekusitiwa yeyase Peuleni, awaye zakele ngokwake um’fundisi izakubehle ilungelelaniswe nomhlaba. Inteto ezibange ukuba kuze kudubula oku siti tina zibonisa ukusweleka kwentliziyo kwabo bazitetayo. Ukuba abafundisi bebala letu siza kwenjenje ukubapata kuya kubonakala ukuba sisafanelwe ngabamhlope esiya kubabeka ngenx’ enebala—into leyo ebonisa ukusweleka kwencambu kobu bu Krestu esizingca ngabo, nokuba asikabi nako ukuzimela ngezetu inyawo. Izi- yalo ezinje ke zitetwa ekuvulweni kwendlu enjengaleyo yom- ’fundisi wakwa Marela, beziyakuba luncedo olukulu kubantu abanjengabo base Peuleni. Sisatemba ukuba indlu eyakiwa ngum’fundisi wabo abasakuvuma ukuba icitwe, ngokuba yaki- wa nguye, kodwa sebeya kuyenza eyabo ngokum’buyisela indleko yake, zebati ukuba bafuna ukwenza entle ngapezulu bahlaziye yona. Intsebenzo enjengoku ngxwelera imvo zom- fundisi ayizanga yabanga uvalo olungenatyala naninina. Into zakwa Tixo ke azifuni kwenzakele uluvo nokuba lolukabani. Siyatemba ukuba soba nokumnandi esingakubikayo ngabemi balo m’mango ngexesha esibala ngawo kwakona. IMPATO YO RULUMENTE OMTSHA. Lenteto ilandelayo yinxenye yenteto eyenziwe yinkulu yalo Rulumente usand’ ukungena— U Mr. Upington ute: Mongameli, ngapambi kokuba kuhanjiselwe pambili, ndinga ndingake ndinazise okokuba ekubeni epumile u Rulumente omdala, nasekubeni ilungu elibekekileyo lase Stellenbosch (Mr. Hofmeyer) lingavumanga ukuyamkela indawo leyo—Umhlekazi i Ruluneli undicele ukuba ndiyamkele indawo leyo. Ndiyamkele ke, nabapati kunye nam sebefungisiwe, nto seyinye ke, kukuvakalisa ngohlobo lolaulo esiza kuquba ngalo. Mongameli, manditi pambi kokwenjenjalo kendenze amazwana malungana nendawo impato le ejonge kuyo. Kwindawo yokuqala, into yokuba kubeko indawo ezibuyiselwa kwi Nkosazana ayibonakali mfuneko yayo, kuba bekungati ukuze kunqweneleke into eyileyo kube kuko into ezizizatu ezibonakalayo, into engekoyo ke leyo okwangoku. Kanjalo sicinga ukuba ngoku iti i Koloni kwindawo ezisemideni yayo izingenise kuyo, ibe negunya pezu kwazo. Mongameli, ngobushushu endinabo bemvelwano nolaulo Iwakowetu, ndicinga okokuba ngoku siti ukuzipata kwetu ngokwetu sikubonakalise. Siyamkele ke indawo le yobulauli ngetemba lokuba ngalo lonke ixa lokulaula kwetu akusayi kubako zinto ziyakubangela intswela nkululeko ebantwini. Ngokungapezulu, asiboni mfuneko yokuba sibe ngabantu abangena kwenza nto ngokwabo, ngapandle kokusingisa ekaya, noko ke asisusi yona indawo yokuba i Nkosazana ibe namandla asongameleyo. sitetela kwindawo yokuba i Koloni ibifanele ukuzipatela ngokwayo into zayo. Kananjalo Mongameli, incwadi ebalwe ngesimo sezinto zabantsundu ebiyanekwe pambi kwetu, inengxelo enganelisi bani, ewe nokuba ngonguwupina endlwini apa. Ubunxila nezifo zizinto ezo ezilweyeliselayo uhlanga oluntsundu. Mna ke ndicinga ukuba ezizinto zonke zibangwa luyekelelo olukoyo ekum’pateni umntu ontsundu, ekubeni kufuneka epetwe ngqongqo. Elam ke mna nelabapete kunye namleli:—Abantsundu abapantsi kwetu mabapatwe ngobubele, nangobulungisa obukulu, kuzanyelwe ukuba bakokelelwe ekuzoleni, enkutalweni, naseluxolweni, basongwe endaweni yokuhlala beyitobela ebunzimeni i Koloni ngemfazwe. Noko ke, qondani, nakuba singa ontsundu angapatwa ngobulungisa, naye makayitobele imiteto yelizwe ; sesitsolele ke ekubeni siwukangele umteto welizwe ukuba ungenziwa isigxekwa nokuba ngubanina okulo. Ukuze ke irafu iqutywe ngokulinganayo, kofuneka sivelise indlela zokuqutywa kwayo, nakuba mhlaumbi zingati zingayi- kolisi inxenye elapa.

JUNE 2, 1884 IMIHLABA ETENGISWAYO. E NDENXA (MACLEAR).—Umongameli wonocanda wazisa kwipepa lakomkulu ukuba kuya kutengiswa, pambi kwe office yemantyi yase Barkly East ngentsimbi yeshumi, ngomhla wa 25 wo June 1884, iziziba zemihlaba emasbumi mabini, emokolo (morgen) ziqala ku 468 ziye ku 933.—E DODOLORO.—Pambi kwe office yomantyi ngomhla wa 27 June 1884, ngexesha leshumi kuyakutengiswa imihlaba elishumi elinamibini ekwelaba Tembu (Woodehouse) ; emokolo ziqala 1,055 ziye ku 3,038. E CUMAKALA.—Pambi kwe office yemantyi ngexesha leshumi ngomhla we 17 July 1884 kuyakutengiswa imihlaba emitatu ; emokolo ziqala esitobeni ziye kwishumi elinambini. Neminye emine Kwazidenge, emokolo ziqala esixenxeni ziye kwisitoba. Abafuna ukutabata kule yokugqibela bangake bahambele ku Eev. Mr. Kropf wase Cumakala oyakuba cacisela izimiselo ngesisa. I ANNIVERSARI E NXUKWEBE. Njengokuba sasibikile, eloxesha likulu kunene kubantu abatsha ngokukodwa labafikela ngomhla we 11 nowe 12 ku May. Lomihla yomibini ifike ise ilindelwe ngentliziyo ezishushu ngabo bonke, ise ilungiselelwe kunene. Kambe isaci sayo kukuvuyisa usapo oluhamba isikolo se Sabata kunye no Titshala baso. Bati ngalomihla abamapandle bahlanganisane kumzi omkulu, kuze kukutazwane kona, kutetwe amazwi okomeleza. Owayese Nxukwebe ngalo Sabata wayengababona kwakusasa abantu abavela emacaleni abeza kubonela. Lomhla we Cawa wacitwa ngoluhlobo : Kwabako inkonzo ezintatu. Eyokuqala yapatwa ngu Rev. W. Holford, umongameli wemicimbi ye Lizwi ne Mfundo apo e Nxukwebe. Washumayela kwincwadi yo Mshumayeli i. 1. wenza amazwi atile ukuqinisa izandla zo Titshala besikolo se Sabata; amazwi afanele ukubomeleza, nalapo isiqamo somsebenzi wabo singakauleziyo ukubonakala. Wawateta lamazwi kubantu abapulapuleyo beliqela elimnandi, nakuba indlu babengayizalisanga. Ekuhanjisweni kwenkonzo kubeko izituba zokuvuma amaculo ama Ngesi nawaba Ntsundu. Intshumayelo yona ihanjiswe ngesi Ngesi, yatolikelwa esi Xoseni ngum’fana esikolwe sagqiba kukusebenza kwake, sakolwa kutyileka kwezwi lake, kukuzola nokusiqonda kwake isi Ngesi nesi Xosa, umfana esite sakumkangela equba umsebenzi wake seva sizidla ngaye singamazi pofu. Kute emva kwe dinala kwangena enye inkonzo, yonganyelwa ngu Mr. Holford, kodwa umsebenzi wayo wahanjiswa ngu Rev. Grana Kakaza. Kute kaloku ukuzala kwendlu kwadlula kanye kunokweyokuqala, lati inani labantwana nabantu abatsha lasimangalisa. Kubonakele kugaleleka nabavela kwindawo ezigama, abalusapo Iwase Nxukwebe, abasezele izinto zale mini. Ukuqutywa kwale nkonzo, ute u Mr. Kakaza wamana ebiza abantwana ngezikolo zabo ukuba babize indawo zokufihlelwa, bacule ingoma ezitile abebezilungiselele. Incasa abaqube ngayo sikolwa ukuba baya kumana beyihlwabula futi abaka bayingcamla. Kude kwisikolo sakwa Nobanda kwako ntwanazana zimbini esite sakuzifaka amehlo sazifunela kwiminyaka emitandatu nesixenxe ngobudala. Zisuke ezintwanazana zabiza zingaboni “ Ulo Tixo omkulu,” zatsho ngamazwana ayolileyo, zatsho kunye, zacengce- leza azayeka, zaziteta ngokucacileyo, zada zaya kupuma zingatintilizanga. Kute ukugqiba kwazo yazidumela indlu yonke noko iyi Cawa kuse tyalikeni; kwasekuxakeka um’fundisi yedwa, naye sati fanukuba ukohlwe sisihlalo sake, uyabonga ngapakati. Zite zonke izinto ezibizwa kule nkonzo zaba zezilunge nelizwi le Nkosi. Indawo esiyipauleyo, yokulunyukelwa ngabafundisa usapo, kukupakanyiswa kwamazwi ngabanye ngohlobo lokude bange bayamemeza, babangele ukuba ilizwi lingangqinelani nesifundo esisakuba sizolile. Enye indawo esiyipaule yavuyisa yona, ngabantwana abancinane abase mfundweni, abasebequba into epilileyo. Kade silila ngokuti tina bantsundu sisuka kade kolu gqatso Iwemfundo, size ke ngoko singaba saya kufika apo sisinga kona. Okunye sibone ukuba amantombazana ngawona abonakala futi enezifundo zokufihlelwa. Asazi ke nokuba londawo yeyokunconywa sinina. Umqubi ntlanganiso ude wayigqiba kumnandi kanye, besapulapula bonke abase ndlwini. Ngokuhlwa kushumayele u Rev. S. G-udula oza kuya kwa Matole, wa- tyila kwe 1. Petios iii. 1—3. waxoxa ngokutobela kwabafazi amadoda abo, waza wabandezela ngokukodwa kwindawo yokuvata—ukutandwa kwako ngabafazi, ukuhlangana kwabo nentombi zabo babulale indoda xa bafuna izihombo zentombi, ukutetiswa kokuhomba lilizwi lika Tixo. Uyingene lendawo shushu umshumayeli wayinyanzela ngamazwi onke abenokuwafumana. Utete washicilela kumakosikazi; zabonakala zigungqa zikangelana inkabi zamadoda sati ngentliziyo fanukuba ziteta esom’fo owati exabene nenkosikazi yakumkulela ngamazwi wacela ukuba kuke kwenziwe umtandazo : watyila unkabi kwesi siyalo siti, “ Nina bafazi lulamani kwawenu amadoda,” wati akusifunda wati, “ Uyezwa ke Sala. Masitandaze.” Ati ukukangelana kwamadoda kwakutiwa ayahlutwa amagunya saqonda ukuba ngoku ati “ Uyezwa ke Sala.” Sikupaule kodwa kona ukuba akavumi ukukangela kwelacala lihleli amakosikazi, singazi ukuba oyika ukuti angabuye afunyanwe sinina! Umshumayeli uyiqube kunene lendawo inqabe kakulu yezivato esiti fanukuba kova, ‘ Abanendlebe zokuva.” Amakosikazi namakosazana ahlale ezole tu, amti buxe ngamehlo sakohlwa nokutelekelela ukuba bayiva njanina lendawo. Kute ukucula kwangokuhlwa kwadlulisela kokwase mini, kwasiku- mbuza ilizwi elitile elihlala litetwa ngum’fundisi otile ontsundu, esiti uya ati akugqiba umsebenzi we Sabata ange umtandazo wangokuhlwa angaya kuwungena e Nxukwebe, ukuze ati nokuba intshumayelo zimposile, ave ukucula kwakona. Okwalo mini kubete intliziyo yomntu 3 opulapulayo kwayi xwila, kwavakala kanye ukuba kuyadunyiswa ukuba kwenziwa emhlabeni umsebenzi ogcobisa ingelosi emazulwini. Iculo elite lonakala xa livunywayo ngu “ Ulo Tixo Omkulu.” Usuke umhlabeli walirolela ingonyana apa engati yeyemihlali yabantwana ; abasuke okunene abantwana badlala ukuyivuma kwabo, badlala befanele. Kusuke kwashiywa ukuvunywa kwelo culo, obekudume ukuba kulungiswa e Nxukwebe ngapezulu kwezinye indawo, ukucula okuncedisana namazwi nokukapela intliziyo pezulu. Kusile kusasa, site sakukangela sati namhla abelungu bevenkile baya kuvuzwa zintokazi zakowetu ezisagqibelelayo ukutenga. Kute kwakubetwa intsimbi wayi vulela umntu indaba, kwepoko imiqodi kumacala onke, yayimirozo yameqela ngamaqela. Lifike ixa lokuqala umsebenzi izele londlukazi inkulu yetyalike yase Nxukwebe. Babeliqela elingapezulu namhla abavela emacaleni abeze kubonela, kwafaneleka ngokukodwa ukungena kwamadodana azititshala, aye funde kwalapa. Ukuwabona kunge kunkwamla inqata lobusi. Isizatu soko make sisishiye. Hayike umsebenzi uquty we kwa ngu Rev. G. Kakaza; kwada kwenziwa into esiyibuka kunene, ukuba umsebenzi onje xa kukoyo ontsundu onokuwuquba, wenziwe nguye. Kufike kwahanjiswa kwangohlobo Iwezolo, ukumka komhla. Kodwa namhla kwafu- ndwa nange ndawo eziteta ngezinto zomhlaba. Amasimnari ade enza into ehlekise kunene : ukuhlangana kwamadodana angene kwiminyango ekangeleneyo, ahlangana esitubeni pakati endlwini, angena enga- maxakaxaka angati avela kude, aqubisana engabahambi. Abuzene indaba sipulapula, apendulana ngendawo zokuhlekisa; ada kaloku axabana aposana ngamanqindi ebanga isonka kwalutuli. Abenom’fanana omhlotshana, ityendyana elifanelwa sihluta salo, lafanelwa kukudinwa kwalo, nobudenge balo, njengokuba belisiti livela kude apo kungekoyo ukukanya. Bekuko nexaka eliqutu, isiqukumba apa esifanelwe bubuxakaxaka, into emsindo ulicekwa, pofu uyifanele ; into ete xa yenza into zayo yafanelwa nakukuqulata imitamo yesonka, esite kwakufikwa kuso sabona ukuba ama Simnari ngoku akasalinganiseli, aselesebenza; kwabonakala ukuba abantwana abancinane abasaqondi ukuba ziya kwanelana ibanisi. Umculo uyole wagqibela, umzi wapants’ ukukwelwa sikolo sentombazana. Kupunyiwe apo kuyiwe kwamkelwa ibanisi, ngabo bonke abahambi sikolo se Sabata ; nabangabantu abakulu. Banikwe amaqekeza amakulu ekeki, atatyatwa zizinto ebezisiti ziyaya kupuma emnyango sezike zaluma kunene. Emva koko kuyiwe emidlalweni apo sifike salubona kona usizi; seva kubuhlungu entliziyweni, sililela abantu bakowetu abatsha. Indawo esibe sizixoxa entliziyweni ibe pakati kwezinye izezi—“ Kulungile na ukwenza imigcobo enje ngalo we Anniversari? Lulona hlobo lulungileyo na olu lokuquba uvuyiso Iwesikolo se Sabata ? Site ke sakudlula apo sakumbula intshumayelo yapezolo; sati sakubakangela abantu abancinane safika benxibe kakuhle kakulu, onke amantombazana etsho ngezintsha, eqalele pezulu eqiyeni aya kuma esihlangwini; sabona ukuba ngulowo uzifikisele. Ukunyula kwabo izivato sikubuke kunene, ngapandle kwe dresi ezintatu, ezite zakubona ukuba zinamabala aqaqambileyo, aba engafanelene. Inkoliso ibitsho ngamabala apakati ekuqaqambeni, sati sakuqwalasela ukucikizeka kwengubo noko asotuka kakulu. Asazike ke ukuba ngubanina oke iqela lentombi zakowabo zihombile aze angazidli ngabantu bakowabo ? Singati tina sibuke kunene nakuba sisiti kube kulusizi. Usizi belulapa. 1. Lendawo yokuti ngalo mhla, umhla obako yonke iminyaka, aze umntu abe nezinxibo ezitsha zonke, kusekuhleni ukuba iyimbandezelo etshonisayo. 2. Akubukekanga kanjalo ukuvata kwentombi zodwa lube udodana olu, ngapandle kwama semnari no titshala, lutsho ngebatyana apa ezisimilo sikolise ukumka nelanga. Into entle tina kukusondelelana kwala maqela omabini kuzo zonke izinto zentlalo yawo. 3. Kube kubi ngokukodwa ukubona ukuba ezidresi zintle kangaka, zibafanele ngoluhlobo abaninizo, bazitungelwe ngabanye abantu. Ukuba bebezitungele ngesingasoli nto ngokuhomba kwabo kubatina sisiti kuhle ukunxiba komntu omncinane. Kodwa intombi engakwaziyo ukwenza ingubo zayo, siyayoyika ; siyoyikisa kom’fo eseva ukuba wati ezinye intombi ziti zakub'aka isonka kanti uya kuda usele ikastor-oil ukuze ulale. Siti intombazana engena kwenza ingubo zayo yoyikeka njengentombazana engenakupeka, ukuhomba kwayo kuyanyela. 4. Sicinge nokuti kazi ukuba kwezi nzwakazi engesiba siya zibonga ukuba singu Hadi, kazi bangapina abantu abahombe ngoluhlobo nase ngqondweni nase ntliziyweni—abantu abake basibona sona Isigidimi esi sodwa. 5. A- mandla entlungu abe malunga nemidlalo njengokuba kusitiwa kuziwe kudlalwa. Kumadodana sibone ibola yodwa; kumantombazana sabona umdlalo abati ngumsino abawugxekayo, esingalaziyo igama labanikaziwo. Owesitatu ube ngumxube wamadodana nomtinjana, umdlalo abati, “ ngamakwenkwe nentombi.” Owokuqala ubuye wacitwa zizipata-mzi kuba kusitiwa uyelele kweyobuhedeni, kwasala ke mibini. Owokugqibela sakukangela kubenzi bawo, ubuhanjiswa ngobutatasholo bokoyika nokoyikana, kude kwahlwa kungeko nto yimbi yenziwayo ngaba bantu baze kugcoba. Site sakukumbula ukuba kanene kuya kuda kube nyakenye kungabuyanga kubeko kuvuyiswa kwabantu abatsha sagqiba kwelokuba lendawo yemidlalo ike ikangelwe ngabakangeli bezinto. Umdlalo omnye yonke imini awuyi kukolisa bani. Ukuba imidlalo yabamhlope ayikasifaneli tina bantsundu kuya ku- nqweneleka ukuba kweyetu kakade kubeko esike siyivunyelwe; ukuba akwenziwa oko ulutsha luya kurabela; luze ukuba loyisile kubeko abati belufanele. Sikulilele kunene ukusweleka kwemidlalo, indawo enobukulu nakuba ngati iyoyikiwa ngabafundisi abamhlope nabantsundu, nangabapati bendaba zamapepa. Into emnandi kunene intlanganiso yabantu besikolo. Nakuba babengamakulu atile ababeko kude kwahlukwana kungaliwanga! Ngokuhlwa kuvakele ukuba kuza kubako itimiti. Siye ngovuyo olukulu, safika sadla kunene, sati xa siginya izonka sizitoba nge teya salulibala nosizi Iwase mini. Kube kuhle ukubona ubuso obungaka bucwayitile. Emva kokudla silindele ukuba kuza kwenziwa inteto, sike sive into zonantsi ezitetayo, xa ziteta indaba zeli sikulo, zingashumayeliyo ; site emini kade sibuka umtinjana, ngoku siseza kuvela amadodana. Site sisajonge apo seva sekuculwa, sakumbula umfo ka Trollope, owati ndada ndafa ngamaculo. Hayi ke noko abe mnandi wona, sabuya saxoliswa noko sibe sirana ekuqalweni kwawo. Bati bakuqukumbela walowo wakumbula emqolombeni wake; yaba idlule okwanonyaka imini enkulu kubantu bayo.

Anderson wase Oudtshoorn, owayitabata ngentliziyo evumayo indawo leyo yashiywa ngum’fi u Rev. J. Hoyle wase Kapa, owayenyuIwe nyakenye ukuba abe ngumgcini sihlalo. Amadoda lawo ke ayenyulelwe ukuyikangelela lendawo asacinga ezinye indlela zokungenisa imali, ukuze inge iyakauleziswa lendawo. Wati emva kokuba u Rev. R. Lide emzuzwini lalama amadada, lite beliba libambe kuwo, tshwi yadlula yona imbumbulu, yafika kwindlu eyayiyeye zinki nezitena udonga. Koko kute ngomzuzwana wangena esiti lanto ndibe ndisiti ndiyitengela inja ndiyitye ngokwam. Kupangwe egqireni, nakuba kungancedanga Into, ible yaqauka yona indoda leyo. E Monti apo ib’ingumfiki, ngomsebenzi ib’ingumaki. ABASINDE E DLISWENI.—Kulamacala angapakati inene elitile labizela esidlweni iqela lezihlobo. “GOVERNMENT GAZETTE.” (PUBLISHED BY AUTHORITY.) IBANKI ZE POST OFFICE ZOKULONDOLOZA IMALI. Umongameli we Post Office unga angake akukanyisele ngamalungelo angafunyanwayo kwi Post Office, ezinendawo ngoku yokulondoloza imali nokuba zimalana ezincinane, awoba neliso kuzo u Rulumente, ayimele nembuyekezo yazo. Ukuqala ungafaka nokuba yisheleni enye, ekungati xa sukuba uyifuna, nakuba ungasekona kulondawo apo wawuyifake kona, uyikupe ngokulula nokuba kukuyipina indawo eyi Post Office egcina imali apa e Koloni. Njengoko bese kutshiwo, akukataleki apo ungaba ub’uyifake kona, ongati mhlaumbi ukuba ub’uyifake e Monti, ngokutanda kwako wongezelele enye, okanye uyikupe yonke, nokuba ukupa isiqingata sayo, xa ke mhlaumbi uyifuna ungekona e Monti, apo wauyifake kona, ungati uyikupe nokuba kuse Qonce, kwa Komani, e Rini, e Kimberley, e Bayi, umhlaumbi e Kapa, ngazwinye yobatalwa nokuba kupina apo ungaba utanda ukuyifumana kona. Inzala yoba yi nayipeni (9d) ngonyaka epontini ezeleyo. Abafazi abatshatieyo, no salpo, ngokufanayo nabanye abantu banelungelo lokuzifakela imalana zabo, elowo eyake; oko kukuti,—ingabi nakucukunyiswa bani. Zonke i Mbumba zamaqela ngamaqela o Buhlobo, ne Ngqwebo, zingazigcinela imalana zazo ngalendlela yokuyi- nqabisa kwa Eulumente, kuba xa zingaba ziyayifuna zoyifumana ngokulula, nangokumsinya. I-Gunya lokuba zibuyekezwe imali obe umana uzifaka, lotunyelwa kwakamsinya nge posi elandela leyo incwadi yako ebika ukuyifuna kwako ifunyenwe ngayo. Ayakufihlwa ngokuzeleyo, ukuze angaziwa ngabanye abantu, amagama abo bafake imali, kunye namanani emali zabo. Nokokuba kukuyipina i Post Office unganako ukulifumana ipepa elishicilelweyo lemimmiso, nemiteto ye Banki ze Post Office, ongati ukuba ute wanendawo ekusilelayo ukuyiqonda, uti ukuzaneza ubalele incwadi engenqweneli sitampu ke yona uyisingise ngoluhlobo,— The Secretary, General Post Office, Cape Town. UMNUMZETU, i Ruluneli, inike isaziso sokuba wonke ofuna enelungelo lokuvota (ukuba nezwi) ekunyulweni kwamalungu e Palamente angalingenisa igama lake kwi Gosa (Field Cornet) elikum’mandla wake, mhlaimbi ku Mantyi we Sitili akuso. Lomsebenzi ke maufezwe ngentsuku ezipakati kolwa 26 lo May nolwa 31 July, 1884 Elixesha belilindelwe kangaka ngabantu bakowetu, nga- ngokuba lifikile nje siyatemba ukuba wonke onayo imfanelo yokungena encwadini yabanelungelo akasakudenda ukulingenisa igama lake. Ukuba nezwi ekulungisweni kwesiko ayizange ibe yintwana encinane kwakwimihla yakudala. Amadoda amakulu ebehlala ebandla imini yonke, ehlalela ukuqonda icala elisinga kulo isiko Ema Ngesini apa ke yinto enonelelwe kunene le ikumiswa kwemiteto ; ngakumbi kuba imiswa, mhlaimbi icitwa yonke leminyaka ihlanganayo i Palamente. Lilungelo elikulu ke lake wonke opantsi kwe Nkosazana ukuba ayisebenzise imfanelo yake emicimbini enjengokunyulwa kwamabandla awenza imiteto. Abo ke balidangaleleyo eli lungelo boseloko besenzelwa ngabalindwebeleyo imiteto, eti maxa wambi ibe yenga kolisiyo. Akusizi Into ke nokuba ati ubani “ Hai mna “ andisakungena kweli sango kuba kuti lakungenwa kuvele “ okubi; sendohlala ndikangele lonto indihlelayo : ”—kuba abo balisebenzisayo ilungelo elo bona baya kuti roqo bali- mise ngokutanda kwabo isiko. Oku sekubonwe yinto eninzi yempi yakowetu emele ezizitili, sitemba sitandaza ukuba kwanga kungabonwa ngabo bonke. Kuninzi esingakutetayo ngokupatelele kweli lungelo; kodwa asixesha eli, nandawo yokungena nzulu ekuliqwalaseleni, le. Eli lixesha lezenzo. Esitembayo ke ukuba amadodana ayakuwunceda umzi ngokuwulungiselela kweli tuba likulu kuzo zonke indawo. Okwangoku singxamele ukuguqulela kweyakowetu inteto ezona nto zipbkeleyo emazigcinwe ekungenisweni kwamagama ; kuba ingemntu wonke omaka ngene. Ako amapepa ashicilelweyo anokufunyanwa ngowafunayo ko Mantyi bendawo ngendawo; kulamapepa onga anganalo ilungelo lokunyula ungenisa igama lake kwizituba ezishiyelwe lomsebenzi: ze emva koko alitumele ku Mantyi oya kulikupa igama epepeni apo alingenise kulencwadi akangelwa kuyo amagama ngomhla wonyulo. Umntu ofanele ukungeniswa makabe ngonazo zonke ezonto zifunwa ngumteto, mhlaumbi ongenazo ezo zicaswa kwa nguwo. Singena ngoku ekuguquleni indawo ezizintloko emtetweni wokungeniswa kwamagama. Lizikulule ibuyi kwesinye isandla som Xosa lo lazifaka ku Mr. Glover, labaquba ke bobabini bebotshwe ngadyokwe nye. Ute u Mantyi akazanga aweve ama Polisa axoka kangaka. Lona eli lingu Carlsen lifanelwe ukugxotwa. Lim’bambe u Mr. Glover lo kupela ngenxa yokuba belisoyika ukuba wolidiza kwesi senzo salo sibi kangaka sokumkonxa umntu lize limsunduzele eweni. Umntu nokuba umnyama, nokuba uluhlaza, nokuba unjanina ngebala—NGUMNTU, sisidalwa, kanjako ngumntu we Nkosazana ofanele naye ukuba akuselwe ngumteto! Yati yakutsho i Mantyi avakala eduma amatyala. Xa sikumbula iziganeko eke sizibone ngawetu amehlo— ezingokwaluka kwentsana pakati kwetu bamnyama kubonakala ukuba lixesha eke amadoda akanyiselweyo ayicedulula into efunyanwa esikweni lokwaluka. Niya- yazi into eyenziwa ngu Abel ngengcinga ukuba mfupi (Gen. iv. 5.) Lipina ikaya labaluki ? Lipina nekaya labangalukiyo ? IMIBIKO. Sicelwa ngabahlobo babafi ukuba sivakalise le mibiko:— UMFI U ELIJAH NTLONZE. Mhlobo wam otandekayo. Kuluvuyo kum ukufumana elituba lokukwenzela lemigcana imbalwa. Ke ndifuna ukukwazisa ngento endihleleyo. U Elijah Ntlonze akaseko emhlabeni. Umke ngomhla we 19 kulenyanga ingu May. Wati xa aza kumka wati lunqweno lwam ukuba ndimke ndisemtsha emhlabeni, wati kusoloko ndaguqukayo ndanqwenela ukumka ndisemtsha, ngenxa yokungcola kwalomhlaba. Watike “ Tata sendizilungiselele ukuhamba ngoku, i Nkosi yam inam noko ndisifanje akukonto. Wati amazwi ake okugqibela ngosuku lomvulo ecaweni wati “ Kufike ilizwi kum lati imini yangomso akusokuyibona,” wati “ namhlanje izulu likaya lam,” wati kwaoko wacula eliculo liti: Nkosi yam ubunditanda ekuhlahlekeni kwam, iculo le 112 kweyama Wesile, Ute ngo 9 wangokuhlwa wasibulisa, xa iya ku 10 wati “ Namhlanje izulu likaya lam,” wemkake. Leyo mini ke mhlobo wam akuzange kubeko enje ngayo ubummandi bayo. Bonke abantu ababeko ngalomini kwaba yinqaba ukuba bemke ngobo busuku, ngenxa yovuyo olwaluko, kwanga kungasa behleli kuba wati culani nina ke zihlobo zam ize nani ningakatazeki, nivuye kuba usilindile ekaya, siya kumfumana kona kwixesha elizayo. Intshumayelo engcwabeni ibibanjwe ngu Rev. S. Gudula. U Elijah Ntlonze wazalwa nge 13 January 1865, umke ngo May 19, 1884. Nobanda, Heald Town, May 19, 1884. UMFI U MRS. JAMES M. DWANE. Ukububa kwenenekazi u Mrs. James Dwane ngomhla wesibozo (8th of April). Ufike apa e Mkangiso selesifa kakulu. Yati lontokazi yakubuliswa yiramente yati: “Ndiyavuya ukuba isicaka sika Tixo sinditumele ukuba maze ndizokungcwatywa nini,” waye enjalo nje eteta ngelizwi lika Tixo, yena ute pambi kokuba abube wati: “ Zifikile kum imini zokuba ndifumane into ebe ndiyisebenzela.” Kute ngamhla utile wacacisa ukuba andisalinde nto ngoku emhlabeni ndiza kumka, wanikela umbuliso ewutumela ku Mrs. Mdaba owaye sifa naye ke, wati: “ Zenindibulisele, niti uya kuhamba ninina, zifikile mna ezam ukuba ndihambe; ” lonto weyiyaleza kumadoda amabini kum naku Rev. James Dwane, wayaleza nokuba atengelwe ibotile yobulawu (scent). Ute mhlana wasishiya wati: “ Huntshu weyisiwe u Satana namabandla ake,” kwakungapambi kwe Bulakufesi ke. Kute ngayo i Bulakufesi kwagaleleka u Mrs. Dwane omkulu, wabonakala lomntu evuya kakulu ute ma yiza ndange wezake, ute unina ndize nomkuluwe wako wavuya kakulu. Wati esahleli kungummangaliso ukuyola kuka Tixo. Kute emva kwe dinala kwafika umkuluwe wake samxelela wambiza wambulisa ke wati ke umkuluwe wake ndizokubulisa, wati hlala wogoduka ngomso, wati akugqiba ukubulisa wati ndiqole ndiza kutshata ngengubo ezimhlope ezimaqaqaula. Wati ku Mrs. Boges beka isandla ebunzi kum ungasusi wabulisa ngesinye. Wabiza indoda nonina nabantwana encuma wababulisa, wati kumyeni wake: “ Ungandibambezeli,” wati yena hai, waza watata iqiya yake wayigalela ubuqolo (scent) wazake wayibeka ebunzi waza wati: “ Isitunzi sokufa andisoyiki,” Amen kwapela ke. Wati lemini wabuba lo, wabuba Iowa wayembulisa. Wenza naye imisebenzi emikulu eloke linenekazi leramente u Mrs. Mdaba naye ubube nge 8 April, 1884. Samngcwaba ke ngomhla wesitoba ka April, 1884. Yayininzi kakulu iramente eyam’pelekayo enditemba ukuba yaba kumashumi asibozo ababe mkokele ukuya kungcwaba yayingu William Mtoba no Mr. S. Magawu, kwakuhle kanye. EDITOR.—Ndiyakwazisa ukuba u James Ndungane omnye wabamkeli be-Sigidimi ububile. Ngati kuyimfanelo ukukwazisa ukuze bamazi abanye abahlobo bake abamaziyo nangokwa sesi Gidimini oko. Yenye yezinto abezinikele ngomqolo wonke ehleli elangazelele ukunga abantu bonke bangasiqonda ubunzulu namalungelo aso kosamkelayo. Ub'ubele apa e Tsojana nge 26 ku April ngo 12 oclock emini. Isifo esona simndululeyo lipika eli- nzima elati kona ngentsuku ezimbini lambandezela nga- ngokuba angabinako nokusa icala pantsi, kupela kusekelwa ngumntu imini nobusuku. Kodwa ke isifo abenaso ngenteto yamagqira ase Qonce o Dr. Ross, no Dr. Egan, bamfumaua ukuba une heart-disease, isifo esingena kunyangwa ngapandle kokuba azigcine ngokute quite, azinqande nakwingcinga ezinkulu, anganxamisi ukutya, angakweli. Lomfoke ite kuye lento itetwa ngalamagqira wayibona noko akabi nakuzinceda ukuba angafundisi, nokuhamba eshumayela kubahedeni, nokubahlulahlula ubusuku etandaza, ndide ndakumbula apo ebekona wakupelelelwa umzimba ngamandla okunyuka imimango yokuya ezilalini nasesikuleni. Yasalela into yokubahlulahlula ubusuku nemini yaza i Bible kaloku yangakumbi ukuyilesa. Esancambaza ukuhamba epumla ukuya emitandazweni yemihla ngemihla yetu etyalikeni, lemihla inkwenkwana yam ihamba imlinda impatele isitulo sokuhlala ayame, yada yaba zezontsuku zombini zinkulu zepika nokukohlela igazi ukwahlukana ne Bible nokuya kutandaza. Into ayenzileyo ngobusuku bokuze kuzokusa enduluka watandazela ilizwi ukuba lihlale endlwini yoyise, likule kwabapilileyo enkonzweni, livuse abatyafileyo, lingene kwintliziyo ezilukuni zabahedeni, nengqola, hba qondisise inceba ka Tixo ukuba nkulu kwayo kwabazivumayo nabazilahlayo izono zabo kulo ihlabati. Ute emva koko wabulela ku Tixo ukumtumela kuyise umoya wake. Ebengunyana womhedeni, waguquka eyedwa kowabo ate ngalo nguquko wakolwa umzi kayise’mkulu wonke, waza uyise wanikwa ingqondo yokutumela intsapo yake emfundisweni abapilileyo nabamanduleleyo ukuya ekaya lopumlo kuyo yonke imizamo yomntu. Ute kaloku umfo omkulu wamemeza xa upumayo umpefumlo wati ewela pezu kwam : “ Gcinani ukutandaza bubom kumakolwa,” agqibele ngalo emva kwelo ukuza kuti cwaka ute kum wandibongoza ngokuti ncama mntakwetu ute balulu wacima watsala umpefumlo wapela. Wangcwatywa ngo 27 ku April nge Cawa ukumka kwemini. Kwaye kulindelwe u Rev. P. Masiza owayeceliwe ndim, akabinakufika, waselengcwatywa zi catechists ezine ezakokelayo ukuya netyeya etyalikeni nokuya emhlabeni wokungcwatywa. Abantu ababeko andinakubalinganisa yayiyodwa eyamahashe evela kwindawo ngendawo. Nakwa Lntuli namaqaba anxiba eza kungcwaba imini enkulu abanye bagaleleka sesisemangcwabeni. Kuko umnyinyivana wetemba lokuba umcimbi wesikolo sase Cumngce (Butingville) ema Mpondweni ungade ulunge. Imbali engengxakeko zesi sikolo iyakufunyanwa kwintetwana eke yako e Palamente ngo 5 June. U-SPEAKER [ngumgcini sihlalo e Palamente lowo] ute ngapambi kokuba u Mr. Fuller angenise umcimbi abenike isaziso ngawo angake enze mabini ngomtandazo ka Rev. Mr. Morris ovela ema Mpondweni. Lenkundla ye Palamente ayimelwe kupulapula imitandazo evela ngapaya kwemida ye Koloni, kodwa lomcimbi ngongafaniyo neminye. Awupatelele micimbini yolaulo Iwasema Mpondweni kodwa unendawana efanelwe ukukangelwa yi Palamente. U Mr. Morris wayetenjiswe ixabiso elitile lemali waza ngokutembela kweli dinga waquba imicimbi etile. Ngoku ungundimangele kule Koloni: kupantsi kwezi zimeko ke upambi kwebandla umtandazo wake. u MR. FULLER ute makuvunyelwe ukuba umtandazo ka Rev. J. S. Morris obekwe pambi kwe Palamente ngo 29 May maunikwe igqugula elibucala ukuba liwucedulule, ze lenze ingxelo ; elo gqugula ukuba livunyiwe libe lelala manene : Mr. Jonathan Ayliff, Mr. Dyer, Mr. Du Preez, Mr. Douglas, naye u Mr. Fuller ngokwake. Ute ukusixasa isicelo sake, ngo February 1882, elinene lingum’fundisi lalinqwenele ukumisa ema Mpondweni, emdeni welipetwe lulaulo Iwe Koloni, isikolo esinjengezo zase Lovedale, Emtata nezinye. Lento uyivakalise ku Dr. Dale, Um’patiswa Micimbi ye Mfundo, wafumana impendulo kwelo nene ukuba kamsinyane zigqityiwe izakiwo woncediswa ngemali zokuquba umsebenzi lowo njengokuba kusenjiwanjalo kwezinye izikolo. Ejonge kweli temba ke zamiswa izakiwo ezafikelela kwiponti ezimawaka mahlanu (£5,000), amawaka amatatu anamakulu amahlanu (£3,5?0) ale mali avela kuma Mpondo, isenzo esingena mlingamso eso embalini yezisa kwabamnyama kumsebenzi onjenga lowo. Lati lakufika ixesha ixabiso ledinga labekwa pambi kwe Palamente, alavunyelwa ngonyaka odluleyo. Okwesake isiqu akakolwa ukuba zonke inyaniso ngomsebenzi lowo zazipambi kwebandla mhla ingazanga yavunyelwa into leyo ; ecinga kanjako ukuba kuko isizatu esikulu emelwe i Palamente ukufeza idinga Iika Dr. Dale. De ibe idinga elo lifeziwe yonke lomali icitelwe ezo zakiwo inje ngokuba ila- hliwe. u MR. STIGANT uyisekele lenteto, wati uyatemba ukuba iyakuvunyelwa. Ngonyaka odluleyo oko yayixoxwa lento wonke wayenga angancipisa imali, engakolwa ukuba lomcimbi wakangeliswa. Esi sicelo savunyelwa. 4 , JUNE 16, 1884.

JUNE 16, 1884 5 UKOHLWAYWA KWA MASELA. U MR. JOHN LAING [omele i Bofolo] ungenise e Palamente ngo 6 June indawo yokuba makumiselwe ukuba isohlwayo samasela empahla sibe sinye—akatswe. Indawo leyo ibange inteto enobom. Ute intolongo ayincedi luto ukubupelisa ubusela. u MB. CROSBIE [omele isitili sase Albany] ute umteto onje ufunwa kakulu ngamafama ase Maxoseni. u ME. UPINGTON [Inkulu yolaulo] ute akanako ukuwuxasa lomteto. Awunabuyambo, kuba umisela ukuba kukatswe nokuba kufanelekile akufanelekile sinina. Ute ikatsi nangoku iyasetyenziswa ze Mantyi xa zitandayo. U ME. MERRIMAN ute uyicase yena ikatsi kuba inganele. Ziko inkibitsholo zabantu ezingasayivayo nekatsi, eziti zibetwa zibe zibeta umlozi [au, sakumbula u Adonis Plaatjes apa.—EDITOR.] u MR. LEONARD ute akwanele ukuba isohlwayo sinqande— kodwa masibe sesinokwenzeka. Into ayicasileyo kukuba abagwebi bamatyala babotshelelelwe ekohlwayeni ngandlela nye. Abanye abantu beba ngenxa yepango, abanye beba nje. u ME. WALKER [omele i Dodoloro] ute abo bamtumelayo e Palamente bayawufuna lomteto. Ihlazo lisekubeni aliseku katseni. Isela kwabakowalo liyanconywa. O Messrs. Ohlsson, A. H. du Toit, Hockley baxasa u Mr. Laing. u MR. FULLER ute into enje ayikazanga yangeniswa nakulipina ilizwe. U Mr. Laing ubemlindele ukuba ingangowokugqibela umntu ongangenisa into enjengale. Ngolwe Sitatu olu ubulelele amapolisa amahlanu ase Xesi—eyona nto ingabahlobo befama. Izohlwayo eziburalarume njengezi azipelisi busela. u MR. WARREN [omele i Qonce] ute into efunwayo asikukwandisa izohlwayo kodwa kukumisela amapolisa. Indlela xa isela elidala lifunyenweyo kukuba livalelwe ixesha elide. U MR. JONES [omele i Bayi] ute ukubetwa kungalunga xa umntu afunyenwe ngokwesibini. U MR. DE VOS [omele i Vusta] uwucasile umteto lowo kuba unganiki lungelo kubagwebi ukumpata ngokutanda kwabo obanjiweyo. U MR. DYER [omele i Qonce] ute uwucasile lomteto angakolwayo ukuba uyakuncipisa ubusela nangayipi indlela. Into eyakude incede kukubujiswa kwe fam. Yinto yoburau ukuba ijaji ibotshelwe ekatsini kupela. O Messrs. Barrj, W. Ayliff, Myburg, M. J. Louw, Johnson, no Sprigg baxasa u Mr. Laing. U MR. INNES [omele Idike] ute yena ukucasile ukukatsa okunjengoko kumiselwe kulo mteto ka Mr. Laing. Akazi ukuba isininzi esiteta lula ngokukatsa saka sambona na umntu ekatswa [u Mr. Myburg uhleke kakulu.] Bangahleka kodwa yena umangalisiwe. Unencwadi azifumene kwabatile abantsundu, abaucase lomteto nobunzima bezohlwayo zawo njengokuba yena ewucasile. Abantu abonileyo bayohlwaywa kakulu napakati kwabamnyama; abantsundu abohlwayani ngobuq'olo. Kodwa bayazi abamnyama ukuba lomteto uyawaputuma bona, bati ke akufanelekile ukuba umiselwe de babe banokuba nezwi nabo ezijurini abekiswa kuzo amatyala abantsundu : [wenze inteto yokutshabisa kwesi situba u Mr. Myburg.] Ngumteto mdala ukuba ubani ufanele ukupendula pambi kwabakowabo. Mhlaimbi ilungu elibekekileyo belingasakuhleka ukuba ubehle walixelela kwasentloko ukuba wonke onemfanelo yokuvota unemfanelo yokuba ngomnye we juri. Abantsundu banalo ilungelo lokuvota; banayo imfanelo yokuba ngabe juri ke ngoko. Yiyo lento ke ebakalisayo abantsundu, uyabuza ke, asifanelekile na isicelo sabo ? Esi ke asisona sizatu awucase ngaso lomteto yena, kodwa kukuba engakolwa ukuba kulungile ukuba ijaji nemantyi ingabi sabinako ukumnika esinye isohlwayo umntu. U MR. HOFMEYR ute okwangoku kusemandleni omantyi ukumkatsa omnyama, am’fake etolongweni omhlope; kodwa ngalo mteto bonke ngapandle komketo bayakukatswa—into leyo ke ebifanelwe kupaulwa ngabanyuli abantsundu belungu elibekekileyo lase Victoria East (e Dikeni). JUNE 16, 1884. IZINTO NGEZINTO. E NATAL.—Beke kwako ulure lokuba u Sir H. Bulwer i Ruluneli uzikupile ebu Rulunelini. MNUMZETU, ndiyaqonda ukuba ilizwi lako libanzi, ukwaza livakale kude ; kauncede ukwaze ngale ndawo umhlaumbi bangade beve no M.L.A. haze 'bafake isandla. Ezantsi apo ndiyatemba ukuba nakuba iko lento kutiwa ngumteto we pasi, andikolwa ukuba uyafana nalo walapa; kuba apo ipasi isetyenziswa nxa umntu ahambayo esiya kwezinye indawo, njengokusuka e Koloni aye pesheya kwe Nciba. Apa ke tina akunjalo, ipasi iyibatyi yomntu, ukuba uke wati ngenxa yokuba umntu osebenzayo kuqelekile ukuyikulula, wayishiya nxa utunywa kwenye indawo, woti ukuze upile ube akuqubisananga nazo inja zakomkulu, kodwa ukuba zikubonile uyakukutshwa ngu Mlungu wako sewuvalelwe kwamnyama amagumbi. Kude kubeko nengqina ezenziwa kanye mhlaumbi kabini ngenyanga. Kwezi ngqina kuye kuti ngenxa yokuba umzi ubanzi, abantu abamnyama abandawonye ukwaka kwabo, bate sa; iti ke ingqina yakupuma ibekise cala nye, iye kubangenela ezindlwini ibabambe bonke abafunyenwe bengena pasi kwelo cala ; ize ke ngenye imini yakupuma ibekise kwelinye icala iye kwenjenjalo nakona. Kodwa ke kuleyo indawo yokubangenela ezindlwini ngebeba bayalungisa, kuba bapelisa ubuvila, kuba iko lempi ifane ihlale nakuba ingaswele msebenzi. Kekaloku into embi yile yokuba bengaketi, kuba ungafana unayo ipasi, mhlaumbi ubuye edinaleni, nxa ungenayo abati ukuyibiza yi special pass exela ukuba lapo kwako ufumene imvume enkosini yako, uya kubanjwa nawe kunye nelo qela lingenazo, ati ukuba u Mlungu wako akaputumanga ugwetywe nawe njengabanye. Into ke leyo ebonisa ukuba akusenziwa ngumteto, kwenziwa kodwa kuba simnyama, singenabani unokusibuzela, kuba nokuba bayakwazi kakuhle ukuba ungumntu osebenzayo, bemazi no Mlungu wako, unga- yivelisanga ipasi kupela uyakulala kwemnyama. Nokuba ungumntu ozenzela ishishinana usaziwa kakuhle kofuneka noko unayo; leyo ke bati yi protection pass. Kambe kuko nabanxiba nezakwa Rulumente (uniform) kanti noko nxa ungena petshana libonisa ukuba ungumsebenzi wakwa Rulumente uya kubanjwa nezo ngubo zako zobu Rulumente. Umongameli we Post Office unga angake akukanyisele ngamalungelo angafunyanwayo kwi Post Office, ezinendawo ngoku yokulondoloza imali nokuba zimalana ezincinane, awoba neliso kuzo u Rulumente, ayimele nembuyekezo yazo. Ukuqala ungafaka nokuba yisheleni enye, ekungati xa sukuba uyifuna, nakuba ungasekona kulondawo apo wawuyifake kona, uyikupe ngokulula nokuba kukuyipina indawo eyi Post Office egcina imali apa e Koloni. Njengoko bese kutshiwo, akukataleki apo ungaba ub’uyifake kona, ongati mhlaumbi ukuba ub’uyifake e Monti, ngokutanda kwako wongezelele enye, okanye uyikupe yonke, nokuba ukupa isiqingata sayo, xa ke mhlaumbi uyifuna ungekona e Monti, apo wauyifake kona, ungati uyikupe nokuba kuse Qonce, kwa Komani, e Rini, e Kimberley, e Bayi, umhlaumbi e Kapa, ngazwinye yobatalwa nokuba kupina apo ungaba utanda ukuyifumana kona. Abafazi abatshatieyo, no salpo, ngokufanayo nabanye abantu banelungelo lokuzifakela imalana zabo, elowo eyake; oko kukuti,—ingabi nakucukunyiswa bam. Zonke i Mbumba zamaqela ngamaqela o Buhlobo, ne Ngqwebo, zingazigcinela imalana zazo ngalendlela yokuyi- nqabisa kwa Rulumente, kuba xa zingaba ziyayifuna zoyifumana ngokulula, nangokumsinya. I-Gunya lokuba zibuyekezwe imali obe umana uzifaka, lotunyelwa kwakamsinya nge posi elandela leyo incwadi yako ebika ukuyifuna kwako ifunyenwe ngayo. Ayakufiblwa ngokuzeleyo, ukuze angaziwa ngabanye abantu, amagama abo bafake imali, kunye namanani emali zabo. Nokokuba kukuyipina i Post Office unganako ukulifumana ipepa elishicilelweyo lemimmiso, nemiteto ye Banki ze Post Office, ongati ukuba ute wanendawo ekusilelayo ukuyiqonda, uti ukuzaneza ubalele incwadi engenqweneli sitampu ke yona uyisingise ngoluhlobo,— The Secretary, General Post Office, Cape Town. KUKE, kufupi nje, kwako udatyana lokuba lamadoda matsha alaulayo akupe umyolelo wokuba mazitshiswe inyonga inkomo zabantsundu kwanjengokuba waka wako ngomnye unyaka. Sivuyiswe kunene ukuva ngomlomo ka Rulumeni ngokwake ukuba akuko myolelo unjalo awukupileyo ; oku kukuti ukuba kuko into enjalo ehanjiswayo lonto ihanjiswa ngapandle kwegunya lika Rulumeni. Abantu mabangafumane boyike akukabikonto, sobabikela sakwalama ingozi. Singase moyeni. Lamazwi siwenzayo siwaseke pezu kwenteto ezimbini—enye ingum’buzo nesalelo, enye iyimpendulo. Incwadi leyo ibalwe yindodana entsundu eti ingu “ MFENGU,” ibonakala kwi Cape Argus [ipepa lase Kapa] yo 16 September. Lencwadi siyingenisa njengoko injalo. Sitomalele kunene sakubona lomcimbi wotshiso, emva kokuba ubengeziwe yile ncwadi, ucaswe ngamanye amapepa endaba ase Mangesini. Uti u “ MFENGU : ”— NKOSI,—Malungana no Laulo olubonakala luuobuvutuvutu obunje. ngokumayelana nempato yabantsundu, kuya kusoloko kade kufuneka abo banga izinto zingahamba ngolungelelwano, nabalitandayo elilizwe, benze iliso maxa onke ukuba u Laulo olo lungati ngobungxamo luposane nendlela eyona iyiyo. Kofuneka ke ngoko amapepa epapamile ukuzivelela zonke inkalo, enze izwi ngamaxa onke. Lungaba mhlaumbi uninzi alukayazi into yokuba, abapati magunya sebenikwe imiyalelo yokuba balungise intsimbi zomtshiso, bezilungiselela ke umsebenzi ozakubehle wenziwe. Ndibalake ngobungxamo ukwazisa uluntu ukuba zisezilungiswe. Ayibanga yintwana nje encinane kwabamnyama, bakuva ngokucitakala kolaulo Iuka Scanlen, nokungena kuka Sprigg onje ngalento yokoyikisa intaka, ukukangelwa kwake ngabamnyama bonke abalapa e South Africa. Kuba ebudengeni babo bona bebesiti, ewile nje uwile u Sprigg akayi kubuya ahlangane nobukosi. Ukubuya bam’bone namhla ikwanguye sisifundo esitsha kubo ngento oluyiyo ulaulo lwasemlungwini. Nokoke ukungena kuka Sprigg elulaulweni kunento enzima okuyigungxuleyo, okungulomteto ungenasiseko we Pasi, owavela ngemihla ka William Ayliff, okucitwa kwawo namhla kube luvuyo kuyo yonke into entsundu. Ndiziva ngapandle kwentloni ndinako ukuti—ukuba u Rulumente ubeya kumana ukwenjenje epungula izinto ezininzi ezinzima ezitwaliswe ontsundu o Sprigg bebeyakude bazihlambulule emehlweni abantu abantsundu. Kodwa ke kona ukuba kuyinyaniso—njengoko ndikolwa ukuba yiyo— endikolwayo ukuba u Rulumente selenike umyalelo kubo abapete amagunya akwa Rulumente, ukuba balungiselele utshiso lwenkomo zabantsundu, ekukutike oko upulula ebuya etyakatya. Nditeta ekopeni kwentliziyo ndingati akukonto inje ngale ukuba yingcapukisa kwabamnyama. U Mr. Sprigg yena lento namhla ingenwa lulaulo luka Mr. Upington, uyazi kakuhle kuba nguye lowa wati akuba eyilinga yacaswa ngobushushu obungaka, obabanga ukuba ade ati enguye abone ukuba obona bulumko bububo kubuya umva. Kona ngokomteto wotshiso abamnyama nangoku abakabi naluxolo, ngokukodwa wati nje u Sprigg bakukalima wabuya umva, kungoku bangokunye kunento abebeyiyo ngalonyaka we 1880. Kumntu omnyama inkomo yinto enkulu, ngangokuba ucukumise zona, sowuyinyatele emsileni. Lonto ke ayibangwa kuba besiti yinkohlakalo ukutshisa isidalwa ngentsimbi eshushu kodwa, eyona nto kuba bebona ukuba olutshiso lwenkomo zabo luyawa lelinye ibakala ekuhlutweni into yabo. Benjenje bona ukuyikangela lento:—Saqala sahlutwa intonga, ukanti kwakufunwa ukuze kuti kutetwa ngotshiso kube sekungaseko zwi, kuba singasebantu. Esitike tina bangabafunaisiweyo sakuba sisiti akunjalo, kutiwe nati sitelela kubelungu. Efikeke mna ndingabi nazwi lakuyipendula indawo yokuba kunganina ke ukuba zingatshiswa zona ezabamelwane babo abamhlope. U MR. INNES KWA GAGA. Ngo 15 September kwabako intlanganiso enkulu yabantsundu abamele umandla wase Dikeni ukupulapula indaba ku J. Rose-Innes, Esq., B.A., LL.B., M.L.A., inene elingumlomo wesi sitili e Palamente. U Mr. Innes ufike ngexesha leshumi elinanye eno Mr. J. Tengo-Jabavu. Amadoda amakulu antsundu ayekolise ngokubako, evela kwindawo ezinjengoma-She-shegu, nomi-Xelo, noma-Roxa, singasateti nto ngo Gaga. Kumadoda amakulu abeko sipaule into zo Tyala, nezo Gulwa, o Ngobe, o Mdeni, o Mshweshwe no Siwundla. Isihlalo sitatyatwe yindodana yase Sheshegu u Mr. D. Sihawu. Esitabatile isihlalo u Mr. Sihawu ucele u Mr, Innes ukuba ake aqubele umzi into enjengendaba ezingamandla zebandla alilungu lalo zalo nyaka. u MR. INNES ute uyavuya kunene ukuhlangana namadoda awamxasayo ngohlobo lokuba abe nokungena ebandleni elimisela amasiko, ekoliseka ngakumbi ukubona ukuba ingwevu zanele kulombuto yanamhla. Isenzo sabanyuli abamnyama mhla bangenisa yena e Palamente sabonisa into enokwenziwa ngabanyuli abantsundu xa bezimisele ukufeza umcimbi. Ba. bonise nezinye indawo umzekelo oncomekayo. Namhla yonke i Koloni ibone into ebalulekileyo, ayakufunda isifundo nama Satlani. Akanamlomo angababulela ngawo ngoxaso Iwabo. Unga kodwa angaqononondisa ukuba balumkele amagama abo angasikwa encwadini yabanelungelo lokuvota. Seleke weva efikile nje ukuba yonke imigudu iyakupeleliselwa ekubeni abulawe amagama abantu abantsundn encwadini. Ubalise ngento ezifunwa ngumteto kumntu onga angangeniswa ekubeni ngumvoti, wati uvile ukuba yinto eninzi kwabamnyama efumaneka inazo zonke izinto ezifunwa ngumteto, eyakusikwa kodwa ukuba ayibangako enkundleni yamatyala e Dikeni nase Ngqushwa ukuba izipendulele mhla kucedululwa izimangalo, kuba xa ubani amangalelwayo waza akabiko ukuzikusela seleya kunqanyulwa ke lowo. Elake icebo kubo bonke abangenise amagama kukuba baze bawomele enkundleni yamatyala ngomhla wokupulapulwa kwezimangalo ngu Mantyi. Umhla lowo awukavakaliswa ; bobuya baziswe ngawo mhlaimbi ngu Mr. Jabavu nangabanye. Maze kungabiko baya kuyimatela ke londawo yokungena esixekweni ngalomhla. Akasakwenza nteto inde okwesake isiqu. Woqauqaula indawo ezasingatwa libandla ezipatelele kubo ze ahlale pantsi ukuze amadoda abuze imibuzo, avakalise nendawa-ndawana arora ngenxa yazo, angati ke amele ukuzipendula. Indawo angabalisa yona kuqala yileyo yomteto wokatso owangeniswa ngu Mr. Laing omisela ukuba lonke isela lento ehambayo malikatswe—kungakatalelwa nezimeko ayibe epantsi kwazo lowo ulisela, nokuba ube ngokulamba, akunjalo sinina? Lomteto yena uwucase ngawo onke amandla ake. Ngesizatu sokuba ebone ukuba uyawa cotela umntu omnyama yedwa. Bayazi ukuba amatyala ngezi mini apulapulwa ngamadoda asitoba ekutiwa yi Juri. Lamadoda ositoba ngamagwangqa oshumi. Ubone yena ukuba akasoze amgwebele omhlope ekubeni makaye kutyakatywa, ngomnyama kodwa oyakugcakamela lonkatazo. Ume yena ke kwindawo yokuba de babe nabamnyama baya kuvunyelwa ukuba babe ngamalungu e Juri—wabe ke umteto ungabamangali—akasakuke abe ngomnye wabavumayo ukuba lomteto ume. Danke kodwa kwibandla lesibini le Palamente lomteto awufumananga baxasi kulo, waba ke uyapela.—Enye indawo awayilwela ngamandla onke yeyomhlaba owawufunwa nga Mamfengu ase Ngqushwa pesheya kwe Nciba. Makube isininzi sabo siyazi ukuba Ingqushwa izele ngabantu, kunqweneleka ukuba bafumane indawo epangaleleyo. Wangenisa, kwindlu engezantsi, alilungu layo, indawo yokuba kunikwe igunya ku Rulumeni ukuba awafuduse Amamfengu aye kumhlaba apa ubusakumelwa ngu Mhlontlo. Lendawo icaswe ngamandla ngamadoda amahlanu ekutiwa ngu Rulumeni ; inkulu yawo (u Mr. Upington) yati abantu abamnyama mabavutywe nabamhlope —into leyo ke yena ayicasileyo, acinga ukuba ayisoze inike konwaba komhlope nakomnyama. Ucinga ukuba okwangoku abamnyama mabanikwe nmhlaba bodwa baze bangaxutywaxutywa nabamhlope. Lendawo awayingenisayo yamkelwa sisininzi samadoda. Kodwa ngemini elandelayo kwindlu engentla, angenazwi kuyo, omnye wamadoda axasa lamadoda alaulayo wangenisa inteto ecasene nesigqibo sebandla labo. U Shambuluka (Mr. Schermbrucker), ongomnye we Rulumeni wayixasa lento kulondlu yavunyelwa. Ngenxa yalenteto yendlu engentla ke Amamfengu akasakufuduswa. Akuko nto ke anokuyenza ngapezulu—na Mamfengu ngokwawo maselezixolisa ke. Emva kokuba ibandla lahlukene uke wahlangana no Tshalisi into ka Buluneli (Hon. Charles Brownlee) ngoku abesinga Engilane ote kuye into abeyilwela (u Mr. Innes) ebandla yinto efaneleke kunene. Bekuyakuba kude kwenziwa into yobulumko obukulu ukuba Amamfengu ase Ngqushwa ebefuduselwe kwela Mampondom’se. Ute ke ku Tshalisi makaye kubikela amalungu e Rulumeni oko. Waya ke; akayazi ke into angaba u Rulumeni uza kuyenza. Kodwa u Mr. de Wet (Um’patiswa Micimbi Yabantsundu) usinge pesheya kwe Nciba. Uyatemba ke (yena u Mr. Innes) ukuba woti emva kokuba ebone waqondisisa ngesimo sa Mamfengu ase Ngqushwa, wabona kananjalo ukuba umhlaba ka Mhlontlo usavulekile, abafuduse abo bantu.—Ndawo yimbi eke yapambi kwebandla labo yengamasiko la zipetwe ngawo ilali zabantsundu. Lemiteto ibizinqum-nqumka. Intlanganiso yokugqibela yebandla iyenze umteto omnye. Wati ke kwakufikwa kwindawo enika igunya lokuba inkomo zabantsundu zitshiswe wafaka um’buzo ukuba u Rulumeni uzimisele ukuluhambisa na utshiso? Wati u Mr. de Wet, hayi. Lahlukene ibandla ufumene incwadi iyela kumhlobo wake u Mr. Jabavu ebika ukuba sekuko intsebezo yokuba utshiso luza kuhanjiswa. Ubehle (u Mr. Innes) wasinga ku Mr. Upington, umongameli we Rulumeni, okanyele “ walala ngom’bele” ukuba kuko myolelo unjalo ukutshwe ligqugula labo. Akufuneki ke ukuba umzi uxalabe ngandawo yotshiso.—Ngapambi kokuba ahlale unga angaqononondisa kubo bonke abantu abantsundu ubukulu bokufundisa intsapo yabo. Uvuyiswe kakulu ukubona intsapo ifundiswa apo kwa Gaga, wakumbula ukuba kanene kunjalo nakwezinye indawo. Into ayigxekileyo bubu- ncinane benani. Lento yokungabiko kwentsapo ezikolweni ivakala futi, eziti ke intshaba zemfundo yomntu omnyama mayingaxaswa imfundo yaba bantu ngu Rulumeni kuba kungeko nentsapo efundiswayo. Imfundo iyanqweneleka kubo bonke abantsundu, kuba, kokwake ukubona, abantu abamnyama ixesha eli lonke bebepile ngokulima nokufuya; ngoku ke abantu bayanda wona umhlaba useloko ungangoko wabungako kwanini. Abanye ke kubantwana babo bayakupila ngokusebenzisa imfundo. Kulungile ukuba abanye babe ngo Titshala, abanye ngamakumsha, abanye ngonobala nabacweli; emzuzwini bekufuneka abanye bengene ekubeni ngabapenduli bamatyala ezi ofisini (Lawyers) nezinye into ezininzi. Xa kunjalo ke abasakubangabalimi bonke. Angavuya ukuva ukuba imfundo iqiniselwe ngabantu abantsundu. Lite lakukova ukwenza lamanqaku lahlala iciko elikulu. Amadoda avakalise imibulelo yawo ngezenzo zika Mr. Innes, yonke lemibulelo yadulusela kwisenzo esihle sokuba ete wafika ukuza kubavisa indaba into abangazanga bayiva beneminyaka emininzi bevota nje. Aqube izikalakalazo anazo kweli lizwe azibangelwa ngama Ngesi la amelene nawo: ezinjengokuvalwa kwamadlelo ; into eninzi yerafu; ukuvalwa kwendlela. Inteto ebalulekileyo kwezi nteto ibe yeyom’fo ka Siwundla wase Sheshegu, iciko lamaciko, ote emva kokuti gqaba-gqaba iziroro ezibambe ukuba njengezi sesizibalule wati eyona nto inkulu ikalisa wonke umntu omnyama kukwahluka-hluka komteto ka Rulumeni. Ubuze ukuba bangapi na aba Rulumeni? Apa e Dikeni bapantsi komteto wabo bodwa, e Qonce ngomnye, e Bofolo kukwanjalo. Abagqibi kuyiqonda ke into ekuyiyo. U Mr. Innes upendule wati iziroro zabo angati ngazwinye zintlobo ntatu. Ziko ezibekiselele kwimicimbi yesiqingata sase Dikeni, ezimiselwe ligqugula elipete imicimbi yesitili; ezi ke u Rulumeni akanakwenza nto kuzo, bangazivakalisa kwasegquguleni apo abanelungelo lokutumela amalungu kulo. Akanakwenza nto ke kwezi. Ziko iziroro ekubonakala ukuba ziko kwabamnyama nakwabamhlope ezingena kulungiswa nangu Rulumeni ezinjengamadlelo angati ngamanye amaxesha u Rulumeni mabadlise emhlabeni otile kanti wobuya ati makuhlaulwe. Ziko kodwa into aya kuzicedulula ati ukuba unako azilungise e Bandla. Lomcimbi wendlela ngomnye wezo. Intlanganiso yaqala nge 11.30 kusasa yavalwa nge 4 ukumka komhla. NKOSI yam Mhleli wendaba zamanene kaundincede kancinane ngamazwana am’balwa, ndifun’ ukubalelela nokukumbuza abalapo ezantsi ngendaba zeli. Kumadoda akwa Sikwati namadoda akwa Ramabulana, namadoda ase Bakhathla, manditi bonke abase Transvaal. Namhla akuko Besutu na uke ubeve benomnqweno wokuza apa e Transvaal? Namhla akuseko Msutu usayicasileyo ivangeli, zonke inkosi ziyavuma ukuba ihanjiswe, kodwa ikakulu abantu bafuna abantwana babo abaninzi abadungudelayo—nditeta abesuka apa ngonyaka we 1850 nowe 1865 baya e Koloni nase Natal nakwezinye indawo. Bati abanye asinakubuyela emakaya ngokuba inkosi zakowetu zivicasile ivangeli : Nditi ke mna okunene bekufudula kunjalo kodwa namhla akusenjalo. Kufuneka nibuyile ngoku nize kufundisa oyihlo nonyoko, abafundiswa bani unemfundwana ete putu, kodwa nina nifundafundile, ningabakokela abazali benu enyanisweni yonke. Izizatu endinibongoza ukuba nibuye ngenx’ enazo ndiyazilandelisa:— 1. Yimfanelo yenu ukuba nifundise amaxego angoyihlo nonyoko njengokuba nitamsanqelisa nabakude abahedeni nishiya oyihlo, ningati mhlayimbi nina anikwazi ukufundisa. Ilizwi litinina?—“ Little thought a book—little drop a brook.” Nani ke nenjenjalo kude kulunge ngofefe Iuka Tixo. 2. Kangelani ukufaneleka kwase Koloni xa uhlanga lunyuswa lusapo Iwalo, inkulelwane zakona. Sekuko nentlanganiso ezininzi i N. E. A. ne Mbumba Yamanyama nezinye. Akulungile yinina oko, Besutu na Matshaka—nditeta oko kwenziwa lusapo Iwalapo eniti nani nincedisane nalo ? Umntwana ubongwa nguyise nonina kuqala andule ukubongwa ngabamelwane, njalo-njalo. Ukuba benivuma ukubuya nalapa kuti bekungaba njengezo udawo nikuzo ukufaneleka. Ekubeni beningati nize neplan zezo ndawo nikuzo. Mhlayimbi ningati hayi lilizwe lama Bulu, kanti ke mna nditi nalapo ako ama Bulu lawo, kodwa kuliwa ngosiba ngezi mini : anditsho yini ? Ama Bulu sinamandla okuteta nawo kwanjengokuba kunjalo apo. 3. “ East and West but home is best.” Kangelani nalishiya ikowenu ngesizatu sokuya kufuna imipu, ke namhla niwuzuzile um’pu omkulu ongu Yesu, buyani ke ngoko nize kudubula ngawo. Niyavuyiswa na kukubona oyihlo behleli emnyameni nabe nina nihleli ekukanyeni? Kubuhlungu oko. Sebenzisani italente zenu kwizalamane zenu', njengokuba u Paulos esitsho, “ Inkanuko yam kukuba o Sirayeli basindiswe.” Nitemba obanina nina abaza kusindisa oyihlo nonyoko? Ilizwi alinakuhamba ngapandle kwenu, abe Lungu abanakwenza njengoko beningenza ngako nina kubantu bakowenu. Umsebenzi we Nkosi uhanjiswa ngabantsundu e Koloni nase Natal. Aniboni na ke ukuba kuhle bazalwana bam nobawo ku Kristu. 4. Abanye basakangele ubutyebi kanfi kutiwa, “Bunamapiko nje ngokozi.” Angatini na u Tixo ukunitamsanqela xa ningalivumiyo itamsanqa aninika lona? Namhla nibizwa ngamagama o Moses no Jeremiah, kanti nibe nibizwa ngo Januaiy, April, May, September, August no November, u Tixo unitamsanqele njengo Jacob or Israel, no Saul or Paul, no Simon or Peter. Buyani lusapo lwakowetu anitakatanga mntu okanye anibanga nto, nokuba kunjalo noxolelwa njengabo abo. 5. Elokugqibela nditi, “Isivuno sikulu kodwa abavuni bancinane.” Nicinga ukuba xa kutetwa ngezizwe ezikude kutetwa ngendawo ezinje ngo Zambesi zodwa? Mna nditi kutetwa nabalapa abakude no Yesu, nofefe, nokolo, nenguquko, nogwetyelo, nobungqina bo Moya Oyingcwele, naba bekude oyihlo nonyoko nibakangele emazantsi elizwe, anditsho yini? Abazi nto ke ngezonto zonke. Zihlobo zam ndisuke ndoyike ndakuwacinga lamazwi. Hayi ukuba kubi kokufa kwendoda ipete imikonto ingakange ihlabe ni ngayo pofu ! Hayi u Esau ukulahla ilungelo lake ngum’funo! Asindoda ebudenge etenga isiqa ngenkomo! Siboniswe umgca wencwadi ebivela komnye wabapakamileyo ekulusebenzeleni uhlanga, nakuba engemnyama ngebala, okwa ngumfundi waso, usiti,—“ Sekuli- “ xesha sagqibelayo ukundileka Isigidimi nje ngoko sibe “ njalo esi sika November.” Ngumnqweno wetu ukuba sisigcine kweso similo, singabi yinkundla yalapo kungcikivwanwa kona; koko ibe kulapo kofunyanwa mdaba ezinefa, nezine lungelo kuma kowetu nje ngoko sesike satsho. Sibacela ke ngoko ukuba bayinakane londawo ababaleli betu ukuti nabo umpunga wolu hlobo bangahlukani nawo endabeni, nasentetweni abasukuba befuna ukuzitumela kuti. Amaxosa amabini, indodana nenkwenkwe, izicaka zomnye u mfama kwakwesi siqingata, adutyulwa angxwelerwa kakubi nge hagile akubon’ ukuba asalungiselela ukupeka inyama yebokwe awayeyibile. Kubungqina obuvelisiweyo kubonakele ukuba ababantu badutyulwe bebekufupi kanye bevelelwe ngasemva. indoda yona idutyulelwe pezu kweziko, yati inkwenkwe ekubonakala ukuba idutyulwe ibe ibaleka, yadutyulelwa mganyana emlilweni. Ute kaloku umbulali emakube kungokuba ecinga ukuti, “ abafileyo abaxeli zinto,” wati ukubancinita wabaqokela ngembumbulu entloko, ezitsho zabusasaza ubucopo. U Mr. Botha ifama, indoda ebekekileyo nesebenzayo emi apo e Menziesberg ihle yabanjwa ngokuranelwa ukuba mayibe yiyo eyenze oko, selek'e wabuzeka ke pambi kwe mantyi yesisiqingata sase Mpofu. Kubonakala ukuba kanye ngeloxa lokwenzeka kwalonto u Mr. Botha ubeye kuzingela ngompu, kodwa ke ubunq'ina obuveliswe ngabo bati nguye umbulali abubanga nasildahla kanye, baye nobunq'ina obunikwe yinkwenkwe esicaka sake bubonisa ukuba ngexa lokuvakala kwezitonga ezo malunga nendawo apo zifunyenwe kona izidumbu ezo, ubesele ese kaya yena, waye nomkondo wezihlangu olandiweyo, kubonakele ukuba akazanga azinxibe, abe nazo nokuba nazo izihlangu zolohlobo. Ke ngoko kukoleka kuninzi ukuba oyena mbulali akaka funyanwa, kusamokomelwa mntu wumbi. Ubusela bungaka nje sinokoyika ukuba zizakuba zininzi izipelo ezilusizi nje ngesi saba bantu babulewe nga langa linye, eyakuti ke lonto ibange ukuhlala kungaviwana pakati kwa makowetu naba mhlope abakolwa ukuba uninzi lwamasela empahla ezihambayo angecala letu. Midaka yekani ububuru ize nitabate icebo esinivusa ngalo kwelinye ibala kwelipepa. 3 DECEMBER 01, 1884

DECEMBER 01, 1884 . IZIFUNDO ZE SABATA AMALUNGU E RAMENTE ZABANTSUNDU. Akuko mfuneko yokuba umntu abe yinzulu yokwazi Izibalo, ukuze ade abe nokusiqonda isimo elalikuso, ububi baso, i Bandla lase Korinte ngexa awalibalela ngalo u Paulosi incwadi yake yokuqala. Ngentsikelelo ka Tixo kuwo umsebenzi ab’ewenza u Paulosi, simfumana exuma ade amise ibandla lika Kristu kweso sixeko sase Korinte sasizele yinkohlakalo, apo ke wasebenza kona iminyaka yomibini waba nempumelelo enkulu. Sekulixeshana ke, emvenikweni kokuba emkile kubo, wabab'alela incwadi yake yokuqala, incwadi awayibalela ukuncencesbela oko wabe ekutyele, nokuya kulungisa ngokunye into ebezite ngexesha lokungabiko kwake zonakala. Nakuba amalungu ale Ramente yase Korinte aye ngamadoda anokwazi, noko ayezaliswe luqanqalazo, nomona, nokuzinikela kwinkanuko zenyama. Kwenye indawo sixelelwa ngemibulo emasikizi kunene eyayikona, ati u Paulosi ngenxa yayo, ayigxeke kunene yonke i Ramente ngokuswela kwayo ukubonakalisa ukusitiya, nokusi- casa ngokungapezulu isono. Ufike kananjalo agxeke uhlobo abablangana ngalo ukuk'umbuza ukufa kuka Kristu,—“ Ukuhlangana kwabo endaweni yokubalungisa kusuka kungenise ukonakala kubo,” waye esiti kananjalo ekwenjeninje kwabo “ baziselela, bezityela umgwebo.” Ukuba ingaba imimiselo ka Kristu ayenzi kulunga kwanto kuzo intliziyo zetu, umayibe ke ibangela ulonakalo lwazo; emayiti kananjalo ukuba ayizitambisi, izilungise intliziyo zetu, ibe iyaziqaqadekisa, zaye intlondi zokukohlakala zifika zimelane kanye nokutyiwa kwe mitendeleko. Make sikangele ke ukuba asinandawo na singazifumanayo zinokwalamana kwezi Eamente zimbini,—eyase Korinte nezaba Ntsundu base South Africa. Ku Mfundisi owenza ngoloyiko nenzondelelo umsebenzi wake, isimo ezikuso ngoku ezi Eamente zaba Ntsundu siyoyikisa, ngenxa yokubola ezibole ngako. Siti esi simo sifike siyipitizelise intliziyo, xa angaba ucinga icebo angenza ngalo ukulipilisa ibandla. Imayibe, mhlaumbi, oku kubangelwa luyekelelo olukoyo ekungenisweni kwabo bamkelelwa ekubeni ngamalungu. Ukwamkelwakwolutsha—masiti intsapo,kuba asinakubabiza ngagama limbi ngenxa yobuncinane babo silinganisa ngabo, intwana ezingekabi nalo nolwazi olupi ngazo Izibalo, nokulindelweyo kulowo uzibiza ngobu Kristu, ukanti ke noko amagama azo selefakwe pakati komqulu wabo bafanelwe kukusihlala eso Sitebe se Nkosi, badle u Mtendeleko; abantwana, kananjalo, abangekabi nalwazi luzeleyo ngawo lo Mmiselo, abazikumbulela bona ukuba ngokuba ngamalungu e Ramente “ basindile.” Ewe, bangaba mhlaumbi banalo ulwazana oluse bunkungu ngayo lento ikuku “Gwetyelwa ngokblo,” bafike ke bati nxwelema apo bangabi nakudlulela pambili; kuba bekuswele ukupaula ukuba, ngapandle ko “Ngcwaliso,” olusisiqamo so “ Gwetyelo,” isadandalaze pandle eyona ngcambu ib’ifanele ukwendela ekunyakameni okungapantsi komhlaba, ingcambu egcina ukuba upile umti noko libaleleyo igala. Bacinga bona ukuba kuyinto elula ukwamkela ubungcwalisa bomnye, bangayinanzi indawo yokuba umyalelo ufike uti, “Yibani ngcwele kuba Mna ndingcwele.” Kungodano nosizi olukulu ekukade siyibona ukwapulwa kwayo lemimiselo ka Kristu kwi Eamente ezi Ntsundu. Lufike u Pehlelelo ne Sityo se Nkosi, ezonto zikangelelwe ukuba zi Lusindiso lupela, ukanti ke yena u Kristu ukuzimisa kwake waye funa ukuba zibe lupau nje kodwa lwanga pandle lwento eyiyo inguquko yangapakati. Indawo yokuti,—“ Manizalwe ngokutsha” kwandulela yona; ngapandle ke kwale nguquko ifezekileyo yentliziyo— inguquko yona ehla izibonakalalise empilweni, nasekuzipa- teni kwake kwakweli—akuko namnye, ndoda, mfazi, na mntwana unalo ilungelo lokusondela e Sitebeni se Nkosi. Kanye ukutya isonka esi nokusela iwayin le yodwa, oko kukuti pambi ko Tixo, pambi kwe Ngelosi, napambi kwa bantu “Mna ndingo ka Kristu, nditengwe ngegazi Lake, ndahlaulwa ngobabalo Lwake; kum ke nobom ngokwabo, xa ngaba abu Naye bulilize.” Akukade sisand’ukubaliselwa linenekazi elitile elingu mfundisikazi kwesinye sezikolo zaba ntsundu e Koloni, ngento eliti yahlungisa intliziyo yalo ngokungatetekiyo. Lalibalisa ngentombazana esikolwenisalo apo, eyavakalisa ukuba iyaguquka; yati kwakamsinya emva koko yalangazelela ukunga ingangeniswa e Bandleni. Ngesimilo yaye iyintombazana ekolisileyo kanye, ekwati ke kuba noko kwakungeko salelo sasingamiswayo endleleni yayo (ngapandle kwesi sokuba isengu mntwana, yaye ingekazivavanyi kananjalo), yamkelelwa kambe e Ramenteni. Kute kamsinyane emva kokuba kwenjiwe njalo, saqala kaloku sayenye into isimilo sayo, saba sibi kunokwa ngapambili. Kwakuba nje kude kwafuneka lento yalatiswe unina. Eyivile unina usuke wati, “Kaloku ngoku ulilungu le Ramente ngoko ke ucinga ukuba akusekwani.” Kwa into yolu hlobo ke yehla kwakweso sikolo. Enye yentombazana yayisifa ngangokuba kucingwe ukuba mayibe yoqauka, ekwati ke ngalo nxa kwafuneka kubizwe uyise, ngokuti mhlaumbi angatanda egoduke nayo. Pambi kokuba emke nayo ke uyise, umfundisikazi wavakalisa ku yise lowo ngomnqweno wake wokunga intombi leyo yake ngeyibe nobunq'ina ebushiyayo ngokumalungana nenkolo enayo kuye u Kristu. Lendoda—eyayingu Mfundisi ontsundu ite ukupendula ibonakala ukuba imangalisiwe yilonto kanye,—“ Yini! ngumntwana owapehlelelwayo lo, kwaye kunjalo nje elilungu le Ramente! ” Ngolu wobelo lokwamkelwa kwama Lungu, ngati kugqatselwe ubukulu bamanani asezincwadini, kwenzakaliswa i Ramente, ize isiqamo sako konke ibe kukubola kwe bandla. Kukade kutandazwa, kucelwa imvuselelo ukuba yenziwe pakati kwetu. Kodwa ke lemvuselelo ifuneka iqalele kobani na? Kubafundisi nabo ngokwabo. Impilo yabo mayibe yengcwaliseke ngokukumbi, bazaliswe ngumonde nenzondelelo emsebenzini wabo, noburoti bokuba bangabi ngamayekelela ekuhleleni oko konakalisa umsebenzi wabo. “Ubukumkani bama Zulu bufunyanwa ngamandla, waye ke nonamandla eya kubufumana ngemizamo.” Mabawapelelisele amandla abo emsebenzini wabo. Kuba ukuka u Satana aliyeke limpuluke ixoba lake ngapandle kokwenza imizamo emikulu, yinto engekoyo; kodwa ke okwangoku uloyiso lubonakala ngati iselolwake. Ngoko ke siti kwi zihlobo zetu ezi Ntsundu ezingama Kristu, (ngama Kristu siteta awenene wona nanyanisekileyo, anozingiso, nantliziyo zinyulu), pakamani nizilungiselele ululwo olupambi kwenu; zibinqeni izinqe zenu. Bubekeleni nxamnye bonke ubunzima, nilungenele utshaba, nisiti njengaye u Jehoshafat wakudala “Ati ke! Tixo wetu, wobayeka na ungabagwebi aba, kuba tina ngokwetu singenawo amandla okumelana nale ndimbane ingaka eze kulwa nati; singazi kananjalo ukuba siya kwenjenjani na, noko ke amehlo etu wona akuwe.” Njengokuba ke elidabi ilelika Yehova, Yena wosinika ulwoyiso, kuba, “ Lowo ungeletu icala emkulu le kunabo bacasene nati.” ISIMANGALO SIKA TlXO (Isaiah I.) 1. NKOSI YAM MHLELI WE-Sigidimi,—Mhlaumbi ungatanda ukumana usiva ngehambiso ye Transkei, nezinto endizipaulayo kuyo. Egameni lohlanga sendizibize ezincwadini zam kuwe ukuba ndingu Tand’ Uhlanga, ngako ndimelwe ukub'ala ngalo. Into yokuqala endiyibonayo yimvula eseloko isina kweli. Aba majojo bahlininika kwa ngo October ogqitileyo, ngoku baya kala, ukutya kwabo kuya dada. Aba masandle bona bati yina mvula. Capt. Blyth.—Senivile kwincwadi ka Mr. T. N. M. ukuba elinene libuyile. Ewe bonke e Transkei apa abatanda ukunyuka kohlanga bayavuya u Capt. Blyth ebuyile nje. Namhla kuya kuvuka imiboniso izinto ezikutaza inkutalo. U Mr. Veldtman Bikitsha inene endilibuka kwa nje ngo Capt. Blyth kwimizamo yokunyusa uhlanga e Transkei apa, ndiyatemba ukuba liyavuya ebuyile nje u Capt. Blyth Lomanene ehlangene nje kuza kuhambiseka imisebenzi emihle ye nkutalo. Ubom obude kuwo omabini. IZILIMO. Umbona namazimba aya linywa kakulu nonyaka nje. Naba heyideni balime kakulu, mhlaumbi bavuselelwe yindlala le ikoyo kangaka nonyaka. Into endiyidelayo kulo lonke eli lapesheya kwe Nciba ngokukodwa kuba heyideni, lelo kubambisa ikuba amakwenkwana; ngenxa yeli siko amasimi aliny wa kakubi, into elandelayo ibe kukwapuka kwemihlakulo, nokunyuka ko kula ngexabiso elingapezu kokuya ibifudula ibanjwa ngamadoda. Ingqolowa.—Kwela Mamfengu na Mangqika ayikatalelwe kanye, into engummangaliso, kuba ingqolowa okwangoku e Transkei apa ine xabiso elikulu. Abanye bakala ngelitye lokusila ukuba lingeko, kodwa asiso sizatu eso kuba maninzi amatye e Qonce, esila ngamanani apantsi, zaye zininzi nenqwelo eziya kona. Lihlazo kuma Transkei ukuba umgubo umana utunyelwa e Koloni umhlaba uhleli wodwa apa. Ihabile,—Yiyo kambe into eke ilinywe, koko ilinywa mva kunye nokudla, itengiswe ngamanani apantsi. Itapile,—E!—zona akutetwa nokutetwa ngazo, zitengwa kwase Koloni ngabe Lungu. Intlalo Yabantu. Ilizwe.—Into endiyipaulayo kweli la Mamfengu (Fingoland) ngokukodwa, kukuxinana kwabantu, nokuba abantu bafuye impahla ngapezu koko ilizwe linako ukutwala. Nokulima, izibonda ziyekelela ukuba kulinywe ngobudenge nase madlelweni. Impahla kwezinye indawo idla imelwe pakati kwamasimi imini yonke. Ngati mna umntu ontsundu ufuya ukuba agqite onantsi nonantsi ngenani, kunokukangela ububanzi belizwe afuyele kulo. Ukuba Amamfengu nezibonda zawo aziyilumkeli lendawo, impahla yabo iya kutshabalala. Ilizwi,— Lomsebenzi ’mkulu unezitintelo ezikulu ngoku kweli la Pesheya kwe Nciba. Kuko ukufa okutile nase zikolweni ezibe zifudula zishushu. Ityalike ngoku ikolisa ukungenwa ngabafazi no mtinjana kakulu, kwezinye indawo. Utywala bukulile kuba heyideni. Ngoku siva ukuba buvuielwe nakuma Wesile ukuba busilwe. Kutiwa kuko ezisilayo koma Gcuwa. Ama Rabe ayakala ngamasela ase Wesile, ungeva umntu eteta ngendaliswana ayifumene kwanantsi. Intseli zabo zona akungeze uve zisiti butywala ukububiza, kupela yintwana kwa nantsi, amanzana kwa nantsi, kanti mhlaumbi kuzele kwezondawo ifatyana, nemipanda, namajoma. Umntu ungeva esiti tunga iwayini yetu le, emveni kokutungwa bufike bulaulwe, emveni koko kubulelwe (ukuba kuselwa esikolweni) kuseliwe ke kubulelwa ngamazwi abuhlungu umnikazi ndlu ngokubapilisa ngalomini. Ndinosizi ukuti ezizinto zenzeka ezikolweni, kanye ama Rabe ngale ndawo anesigxeko.—Lingatinina ke ukuhamba ilizwi xa kunje? Imfundo,—E! imfundo yona ngaba heyideni ayikatalelwe kanye, Bati uti umntwana womntu akufundiswa alahle uyise nonina ahambe ezweni, ahole nokuhola. Enye into bati ipina imizi yabantu abafundileyo? Intlanti nenkomo zabo zipina? Bambona bona umntu ofundileyo eli hilihilana, neqokolwana elipile ngokutshonisa abangafundanga. Laye ilixokana eliya kuhamba likumsha, lilahle nenteto yakowalo kweza ndawo zikude. Lendawo ke aba heyideni ngazwinye e Transkei apa bankontele kuyo, ebudengeni, ukuba abafuni kubatumela ezikolweni abantwana babo. Inkutalo. Inkutalo asikuko nokuba ndiyayibuka nokuba yeyalupina uhlobo. Xa umntu atabate imisebenzi yenkutalo pakati kwaba ntsundu e Transkei apa nase Koloni, nabamnyama bamanye amazwe, angafumana tina sise mva ezantsi kanye. Ngati mna e South Africa apa eyona nto inkulu kwaba ntsundu—ngokukodwa ku Maxosa na Batembu— kukuba umntu abe ngoka nantsi, mhlaumbi abe sisibonda. AMABALANA AHLEKISAYO. ISAZELA. Lento isazela yinto ati wumbi umntu akokelwe yiyo, iti ukumkokela kwayo, imncede wonke ubani ovumay’ ukulandela, nokukokelwa sisazela sake. Kuti kuwumbi umntu ngalonxa, ade afumane mhlaumbi isigxeko kwabanye abantu sokuba—Uligwala, unanina lento adla ngokuti, lemihla yena uyeva kwasemxelweni wake ukuba kulungile oku; akulungile okuya ? Kuti kungenjalo kutiwe lomntu unenkani; kuba xa sukuba selete hayi mna betu ndiyoyika, mhlaumbi hayi lonto niyitetayo ayikulunga yiyekeni, sendisiva kwase mxelweni ukuba akulungile, atsho kupele; kutiwe lomntu utanda izwi lake, okunye unenkani, okunye ke ligwala. Lembalana ke ilandelayo yobonisa umntu wonke umsebenzi wesazela kumniniso. Kwati kule minyaka ipambi ko Ngcaye-c'ibi kwesuka amadoda amabini e Bayi egoduka, esiya e Nqushwa. Eza kufika ke e Rini kusalunge konke. Egqitile kona yati indlela yawo yalata e Zitshangana kwindawo esey’ilinxowa, eb’ ifudula ihlala ononq'ayi kudala. Kute ke kuba lowo umhlaba bawuza sekuhlwile, litshonile nelanga; wavakala omnye esiti kuwabo “Mfondini ndiyoyika.” Uvakele uwabo esiti “Yinile mfondini, uyindoda yantoni le ifumane yoyike emin’ apa, kungekati ‘ratya nocoloti; kube kunjalo nje kungeko nanto le ibonakalayo, nevakalayo nasezindlebeni engoyikisa umntu, nokuba ibingo yinkazana, nokuba ngumntwana, nokuba ngoligwala njengawe? Uti uyoyika, woyika ntoni?” Ute Uwabo: “Ndiyoyika mna, ndoyika ingonyama.” Omnye: “Ipi longonyama?” Uwabo: “Ndiyayiva siteta nje iyagquma.” Omnye: “Mawo! mawo! uti ipi na, uyiva igquma pina, lento ndingayivayo mna inani na? Musa mfondini ukumvumela u Satana ukuba akulaule kangaka.” Uwabo: “Hayi mna ndiyoyika.” Kuqubeke ngolohlobo ke behamba nje; kwabonakala emzuzwini ukuba umntu uyoyika impela, suke yenene, yenene, wapela nokuhamba, babe sebekufupi kaloku kweli nxowa lamapolisa. Udati ngelinye ixesha kuwabo lo ungoyikiyo,—“Kodwa wena akuyiva na igquma kangaka nje ?” Ati ke omnye ukupendula,—Ke mfondini, namhla ndikuncamile, tu akuko budoda banto kuwe apa. Kwanobu bugqobokana bako namhlanje andibazele nto, bugqbbbkana bakwa Satana.” Ute uwabo,—“ Nokuba sekunjalo ndiyoyika mna, ndoyika ingonyama, ndiyayiva mna, iyagquma ; iyeza nokuza isel’ikufupi, nokuba wena akuyiva, akuyoyiki.” Bafikile ke kweli nxowa, bafika liseko igxokogxoko lendlu elingasena ngc'ango, nafestile. Bengene, ufike lowa ungoyikiyo waseleyiposa pantsi ihabilisaka yake, wati ‘rutu idosha yake yematshisi, qwiti danga. Kute kusenjalo wabonakala amehlo selewamise emnyango, kwa kwela cala kute kusiti danga lematshisi aye amehlo ka wabo ebesele nxalange ngakona kade ; kuba yena ubesele njengento esel’ifile kade! Ujonge ke wajonga wabonakala selezileta pezulu ezibalikeni zeli gxokogxoko esiti kuwabo, “ Ngxama, kwela mfondini, sesinyatelwe yingonyama obukade undityela ngayo, ndikugxbka, ndikunyelisa, ndikup'ikisa.” Ute esiti qabe eb'alikeni yab’ iselingena ngobutyututyutu nobunxamo,. obukulu kunene ingonyama. Qu, ngapi; qu ngapi; kwati kusezi kambileni, ipate kumisa kwapandle, ibe iposeka napakati, suke yayi ngqushu. Ivakele iqubisana nehabilisaka eziya, kuba akubangako xa lakunyuka nazo, yaqwenga ivutulula ngomsindo, izidlikidla, sekumane kuvakala ukujuba kwe tikana ebezipakati, eti nayo yakuva kusiti “kence” pi ibisel’iposeka kulondawo. Ibe yilongqushu ke obu busuku; kuba kaloku ivuinba eli labantu iyaliva ukuba bako endlwini apa, kuseloko ayiboni, kumnyama. Okunye ke nayo, ngenxa yobunxamoi nomsindo, ayikange ilinde, iqondise kakuhle apo bangaba bakona, pofu iqonda kona ngevumba ukuba basendlwini apa. KAYSER, UZELWE, May 1828; UBUBE, May 1885. AMAKONCO asixokelele kokudluleyo aman’ ukuvutuluka ngamanye. Kodwa, makabulelwe u Tixo kuba evutuluka ekwenzile okwawo ukubambelela kulomqokozo waye utsalwa zinkabi ezakubela tanci intsinde zobudenge, nobuginwa beli hzwe ; ekungoko namhla okudala kuzele okutsha. Ngolwe-Sine evekini, ngosuku Iwa 20 ku May, 1885, kubube e Alice u Mrs. FREDERICK KAYSER, umfu- ndisikazi wase Xesi, wesikolo esibizwa ngo GQADUSHE. Ube esel’ enexesha egula, ade afuduke nje e Knapp’s Hope apo, eze kule dolopu. Ngonyaka we 1821 emva kwemfazwe yama-Linde, kwa- galeleka e Tyume—eli lizwe ise lelama Ngqika oko—abafu- ndisi ababini u Rev. W. R. THOMSON, no Rev. JOHN BENNIE, betunyelwe yi Glasgow Missionary Society ; besiza kukanyisela amakowetu. U Mr. THOMSON useko, nanko ngoku esalupalela kwelama Lawo e Katala. U Mr. BENNIE yena, sel’eneminyaka wabizelwa umvuzo wake ezulwini. Nguye umseki woluhlobo lokubalwa, nokushi- cilelwa kwenteto yakwa Xosa, olu lusetyenziswayo ngoku- Incwadana zezikula zosapo, nezokutyila inteto; kwane nguqulo ye Zibalo, nguye owazib'inqela kwasekuqaleni, ezite inkoliso jezo ncwadi zokuqala yashicilelwa kwa nguye. Isishicilelo safika ngomhla we 16 ku December 1823, e Tyume, sisiza no Rev. JOHN Ross, M.A., uyise wabo bafundisi belogama bazekayo kunene, u Mr. BRYCE no RICHARD BOSS. Kute ngolwe sitatu usuku sifikile, oko kukuti nge 19 ku December lowo, bashicilelwa ngu Mr. BENNIE O “A, B, C,” bokuqala besi Xosa e South Africa, nakuba ngezo mini bebedweliswa kutiwe kuqala: “ A, E, I, O, U.” Lentokazi ke namhla isishiyayo ib’ iyintombi ka Mr. BENNIE enkulu,—kuba zimbini kupela ezikoyo. Igama layo ib’ ingu SARAH MARGARET. Yazalelwa e Rafu ngo mhla we 5 ku May 1828, ekute kuba uyise ebe ngumfundi- si wase Lovedale yasingena apa isikula, yaba ngomnye wosapo olufundiswe apa ke ngoko. Ekuhambeni kwemin- yaka, kodwa, wafudukela e Middelburg uyise: wabe ke naye umfikazi lowo sel’eyi ntombazanana ete dlundlu, enjalo nje ete ekukuleni kwake wabehle intliziyo yake wa- yibekela emsebenzini we NKOSI. Befikile e Middelburg uyise uhle wavula isikula sosapo, yaza iutombi yake yangu mncedisi olitemba kulomsebenzi, nakuba kodwa ite yaxakwa bubulwelwe buka nina ekuzifezeni zonke imfanelo zawo; kuba kaloku xa kunjalo eyendlu yakowayo ib’ ikwapetwe yiyo. Nje ngokuba intliziyo ka Mr BENNIE ekwelo lipakati nje, ib’ingazanga ixole ukushiya isizwe sama Xosa esona aqale kuso ukusebenza, waye ukwanjalo umxelo wentombi yake, ete kanti nayo inebbngo elingapeliyo lokuba ngu mfundisikazi pakati kwesizwe esintsundu, itwale ingcikivo zeso simo kunezinye iziyolo zamanye amaziko. Lite ke ngoko lakufika isoka langasema-Xoseni u Rev. FREDERICK G. G. KAYSER, malunga nomnyaka wokungena kwe Mofu, 1855, yapuma lontokazi ebuntombini, yamkela ubufundisikazi No. 191. besikolo sase Knapps Hope, e Xesi kwa GQADUSHE. Ufikele endlwini ka yise-zala, ka Rev F. KAYSER omdala, ate unyana wasel’ehlala kuyo bada babuba abazali bake, inanamhla isekwa yilondlu yomfundisi weso sikolo. Bobabini ke batyikitya kona ubala olu, belinga ukunqika ilitye esingaziyo ukuba lancanyatiselwa ngatywina laluhlobo Iunina kangaka. Asiyi kungena kwincazo yokuma komsebenzi wabo nenkata-nkatazo ezawupahlayo. Kwanele ukuba sibabikele abafundi be Sigidimi, ukuba pakati kwako konke u Mrs. KAYSER uyitwele iyokwe yake ngonyamezelo lobu-Kristu, nangesimilo sabalaulwa ngu moya, notando lo Msindisiwa-BONI. Uwufezile ke umsebenzi wake namhla, eshiya umzekelo omhle onemfundiso kubo bonke abamaziyo; nakulo ibandla abesebenza pakati kwalo, abe ngunina walo ngokwa sempe- fumlweni; kuba ub’elinceda ngokulifundisa izibalo ezikuleni zecawa, elifundisa nge hambo nemikwa yake; elondla nge ziyalo, elonga ngamazwi ancedayo kwaba ntliziyo zifayo, zinamatidala. Kanjalo uncedise kakulu kulomsebenzi wokuputuma abaninzi kolu tshaba lotywala. Ube ngu Mbali we ntlanganiso ye Tempile ya Bazili Benene yeso sitili. Uyalilelwa kunene ngabo bonke abantu abamaziyo, naba- mhlope kwanje ngaba ntsundu. Baninzi kwiremente yase Xesi abangasokuze bamlibale amazwi ab’ewateta; umzekelo awushiyileyo pakati kwabo wobume bobu-Kristu; wonyamezelo pantsi kobunzima; umonde wokutundeza izidenge; wokunqotola abapambukayo ngamazwi apolileyo, afezayo, angena emxelweni. Umsebenzi wobufundisi ub’ ewubinqele kanye ade alaliswe nje sisandla sokufa. Kwizihlobo zake, nabantwana bake ushiye intutuzelo, ekumkeni kwake; eb’ehleli enjalo kade emikweni yempilo yake. Ku Mfundisi obe ngumyeni wake, ukwashiye intutuzelo, kuba uyazi ukuba akafile ulele ubutongo boyolo kuye u KRISTU, ukulindela ixesha lovuko kwabafileyo. Ezindawo zilishumi zizonke, sizibone kwelinye ipepa kwawa Mangesi, zindawo zokufundwa zigcinwe ngabo bakulo msebenzi, zibe ngummiso wabo ekuwuqubeni. Zizo ezi zilandelayo :— I. Yiqonde itekisi, yalamanisa nenteto ezindala ukangele ukuhlangana okukoyo. Ungake ubonise imfundo yako ekushumayeleni; keta amadlisa angabakoyo emfundweni yako; yiba nemfundiso entshumayelweni yako. Yilungiselele intliziyo yako e Nkosini, kwa namandla avela ngapezulu. II. Caza kunene intshabalalo atshabalele ngayo umntu, nendlela angasinda ngayo, nokuhlaziywa kwake ngu Moya Oyingcwele; cana imfundiso ofundisa ngayo, tyebisa ngamakade ubona, ngokwenza kwako. Shumayela inyaniso ze Vangeli ngokwemikwa, nenyaniso zokwenza kwako zibonise nge Vangeli. III. Mxumise u Msindisi, ’mtobe umoni, uze uhlonele u Moya Oyingcwe- le. Yikumbule i Nkosi yako, funa uzuko Lwayo, ungafuni olwako, Buve ubuko buka Tixo, kumbula ukuba ungumsebenzi wezandla zake. nokuba ufunjatiswe inyaniso Yake. IV. Yiti xa utetayo wenze amanqaku amafutshane ungatyondyoti, utete ngokucacileyo. Yiti indawo oya kushumayela ngayo uhlale unayo engqondweni nase ntliziyweni yako, ungati xa ushumayelayo umane uqondele encwadini, teta ngezwi lako odalwe wanalo, ngokuzola ngesd'ima, nangegunya elinesitozela; ngapezu konke, yiba nenyameko enotando, nentsika-mbilini enofekefeke. V. Ungashumayeleli kucaza isibalo kodwa, jonga ekusindiseni imipefu- mlo. Intshumayelo yako mayiti dzu ibekise entliziyweni, nakwisazela utetise ngobuganga, uyale ngotando, uze ukutaze ngentliziyo yonke. Uvalo lopulapulayo lungakuwe. VI. Shumayela kwindidi zonke, kwabelizwe, kwabakonza ngezenzo negama; abanditayo, abaguqukileyo, nabakonza u Tixo, Xa sukuba ubuza imibuzo, yibuze ngokundilekileyo, uze unike iziyalo ezishushu, nezihlabayo, nezifezayo. Shumayela eziqwini zabantu, ungabacezi, ungasiki eboyeni njekodwa, ungagqwizili, bacane. VII. Shumayela nje ngopambi ko Tixo, nje ngoqaukayo, eshumayela kwaba kwanjalo. Wukuhlala ukumbula ukuba uyakuhlangana nabapulapuli bako ngomhla womgwebo. Umvuzo wako awukona emananini angakananina, kodwa uya kuvuzwa ngenani lomsebenzi wako. VIII. Tandaza kunene egumbini lako. Yiti ukuya kwako kushumayela ube kuxa uvela kutandaza, upume uye etyalikeni; uti emva kwentshumayelo, utandazele intsikelelo yalontshumayelo. IX. Umfundisi makancamele konke azibandezele; makwazi ukunyamezela ubunzima, nokuxamleka, nokucukucezwa. X. Shumayela ngemik'wa yako. Hamba kufupi naye u Tixo wako, mayiti inguquko yaboni ilale kufupi entliziyweni yako. Ixesha lifutshane, ubomi abunangqiniseko, unapakade ukufupi. AMABAL’ ENGWE.
